"LA ESPADA CELESTIAL
ENCARGO MAESTRO DEFINITIVO PARA IA GAME LAB
RPG DE FANTASÍA ÉPICA — OBJETIVO: ASPIRAR A GOTY
INSTRUCCIÓN PRINCIPAL:
Quiero que desarrolles LA ESPADA CELESTIAL, un videojuego RPG de fantasía medieval, acción, aventura, exploración y criaturas coleccionables. No quiero una simple demostración, una maqueta, una presentación, una biblia de diseño ni un escenario con botones decorativos. Quiero un videojuego real, jugable, funcional, profundo, original y profesional.
La ambición es crear un título capaz de competir algún día entre los mejores videojuegos del mundo y aspirar al premio GOTY (Game of the Year).
No afirmes que el juego ha ganado o merece un premio sin haberlo conseguido. El GOTY es nuestro objetivo de excelencia, no una promesa.
Debes trabajar sobre las capacidades reales de IA Game Lab, inspeccionar el proyecto existente y utilizar las herramientas disponibles para construir el juego. No inventes funciones que la plataforma no pueda ejecutar. Si algo no es posible, explica la limitación y desarrolla la mejor alternativa técnica.
---
1. IDENTIDAD DEL VIDEOJUEGO
Nombre: LA ESPADA CELESTIAL.
Género: RPG de acción, fantasía medieval, aventura, exploración, combate y colección de criaturas.
Plataforma prioritaria: Android.
Orientación: Horizontal.
Idioma: Español de España.
Estética: Fantasía medieval cinematográfica con personalidad anime, escenarios detallados, iluminación espectacular, personajes originales y efectos visuales de alta calidad.
Inspiración: La profundidad de los grandes RPG, la libertad de exploración de las aventuras clásicas y la emoción de coleccionar criaturas, sin copiar personajes, diseños, música, historias ni propiedades intelectuales existentes.
El juego debe tener identidad propia y ser reconocible por su universo, personajes, criaturas, música y dirección artística.
---
2. OBJETIVO DE CALIDAD: NIVEL GOTY
Diseña y desarrolla el juego siguiendo estándares de excelencia en:
Jugabilidad.
Combate.
Historia.
Personajes.
Mundo.
Exploración.
Diseño artístico.
Música y sonido.
Animaciones.
Inteligencia artificial.
Interfaz y controles.
Rendimiento.
Accesibilidad.
Profundidad de sistemas.
Originalidad.
Cada sistema debe aportar algo al conjunto.
No quiero cantidad sin calidad.
No quiero un mundo enorme vacío, enemigos repetidos, misiones genéricas ni habilidades que no tengan utilidad.
Quiero una experiencia memorable.
---
3. UNIVERSO E HISTORIA
El mundo está formado por regiones conectadas por una historia épica.
Región inicial: VALDORIA
Una tierra de aldeas, bosques, praderas, ríos, montañas, ruinas y antiguas civilizaciones.
Aquí comienza la aventura.
Región de DRAKMOR
Territorios volcánicos, fortalezas, ciudades devastadas, bosques oscuros y criaturas corrompidas.
Región de KANSORDORE
Templos celestiales, ciudades antiguas, bibliotecas prohibidas, dimensiones alternativas y misterios relacionados con el origen del mundo.
Elementos fundamentales de la historia
La Gema Celestial.
La Jarra de Origen.
La Lágrima de la Primera Brasa.
La Profecía de Jugador Cero.
La Convergencia Absoluta.
El Despertar.
La Resonancia.
El Velo.
La Ruptura.
La Ascensión.
Construye una historia original, coherente y emocionante, con misterios, revelaciones, conflictos, decisiones, consecuencias, personajes memorables y un final satisfactorio.
No reveles todos los misterios al principio.
La historia debe desarrollarse mediante acontecimientos jugables, diálogos, exploración y escenas cinematográficas.
---
4. PROTAGONISTA
Crear un protagonista personalizable.
Permitir configurar, según las posibilidades técnicas:
Nombre.
Rostro.
Pelo.
Color de pelo.
Ropa.
Armadura.
Casco.
Accesorios.
Armas.
Estadísticas
Vida.
Maná.
Resistencia.
Fuerza.
Defensa.
Velocidad.
Inteligencia.
Suerte.
Cada atributo debe tener efectos medibles.
El equipamiento debe modificar las estadísticas y, cuando sea viable, la apariencia del personaje.
Crear animaciones diferenciadas de reposo, caminar, correr, atacar, esquivar, bloquear, recibi
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL”, a real, playable, original action-fantasy RPG for Android/browser (horizontal, Spanish from Spain) with 3 regions, combat, exploration, creature collection, customizable protagonist, story, UI, audio and high production ambition; GOTY is an aspiration, never a claimed award.

## Requirements
- Must be a real playable game, not a demo/design document/mockup.
- Original universe, characters, creatures, story, music and art; no existing IP.
- Regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats (Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte) with measurable effects and equipment affecting appearance where viable.
- Mobile-first horizontal layout, usable touch controls, Android support; Spanish (Spain).
- Quality targets: gameplay, combat, story, characters, world, exploration, art, music/sound, animations, AI, UI, performance, accessibility, system depth, originality.
- Do not invent unsupported platform capabilities; explain limitations and provide best alternative.

## Decisions
- Build as a Vite + Three.js browser game with procedural 3D visuals, Web Audio music/SFX, Canvas UI/maps, localStorage saves.
- Use 3 separate zones loaded via portals rather than one continuous world.
- Stylized low-poly/toon 3D with procedural terrain, props, structures, characters and creatures to avoid external assets and licensing issues.
- Bundle fonts locally (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`) under `public/fonts`.
- Main systems: third-person camera, 3-hit melee combo, dodge i-frames, block/parry, stamina, two class skills, creature capture/summon/upgrade, equipment/attributes, quests/dialogues/choices, waypoints/fast travel, shop, accessibility, auto-save.
- Eight creatures: Lumifín, Bramiel, Grímpola, Brasal, Umbrino, Cineronte, Petreluz, Celemn.
- Three classes/juramentos: Guardián, Filo, Vidente.
- Main quest chain of 13 quests plus 5 side quests.
- Endings: open or close the Velo, with epilogue influenced by choices/resonance.
- UI orchestration split into multiple classes to avoid oversized single file.
- Settings/audio/menu from title use overlays; gameplay pause menu is a separate screen.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repo; it was essentially empty except agent scaffolding, `README.md`, `start.sh`, `capture.sh`.
- Created project scaffold: `package.json` (Three.js ^0.187.0, Vite ^8.3.5), `index.html`, favicon, local fonts.
- Downloaded and bundled `cinzel.woff2`, `cormorant.woff2`, `cormorant-italic.woff2` into `public/fonts`.
- Wrote full CSS design system and responsive/touch/UI styles in `src/style.css`.
- Implemented utilities: `src/utils/math.js`, `src/utils/noise.js`.
- Implemented data: items/equipment/classes/difficulties, creatures, enemies/spawns, quests, zones/terrain/layouts, dialogues including story scenes and endings.
- Implemented systems: `AudioEngine` (procedural adaptive music + SFX), `Save`, `Input` (keyboard/mouse/touch/gamepad), `QuestManager`, `stats.js`.
- Implemented UI core: boot, HUD, joystick/buttons, dialogue typewriter, minimap/full map, toasts, banners, target/boss bars, cinematic subtitles, damage numbers.
- Implemented `TitleScreen`, `CreationScreen`, `MenuScreen` core tabs (personaje/equipo/inventario), `MenuExtra` (criaturas/misiones/mapa/ajustes/sistema/shop/help/credits).
- Wrote procedural SVG portraits in `src/ui/portraits.js`.

### Active
- `src/ui/MenuExtra.js` was just created; not yet syntax/build-tested.
- `src/ui/UI.js` has a known patch already applied for terrain color handling (removed undefined `THREEColor`).
- Need to create `src/ui/EndScreens.js`, `src/main.js`, `src/core/Game.js`, `src/core/Dialogue.js`, world/entity/fx modules, and connect everything.
- Need to verify/repair references and syntax before build.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Create `src/ui/EndScreens.js` implementing `showDeath`, `hideDeath`, `showEnding`, `showCredits` (ending screen, credits, retry/load/title).
2. Implement remaining engine modules: `src/core/Game.js`, `src/core/Dialogue.js`, `src/world/World.js` + terrain/structures, `src/entities/Player.js`, `Enemy.js`, `Creature.js`, `NPC.js`, `src/fx/Effects.js`, `src/main.js`.
3. Wire all imports and method names used by UI/data, including `game.openMenu`, `closeMenu`, `beginCharacterCreation`, `setCreationPreview`, `startNewGame`, `continueGame`, `returnToTitle`, `saveSummary`, `quests`, `world`, `zones`, `player`, `save`, `inventoryCount`, `addItem`, `useItem`, `equipItem`, `spendAttribute`, `summonCreature`, `upgradeCreature`, `buyItem`, `fastTravel`, `isWaypointDiscovered`, `openShop/closeShop`, `startBossFight`, `spareVarok`, `consumeVarok`, `queueEnding`, `finishEnding`, `applySettings`, `autoSave`, `saveGame`, `loadGameFromMenu`, `resetSave`, `openMenu/tab`, `cameraYaw`, `skipCinematic`.
4. Run `npm install`, `npm run build`, fix syntax/module errors.
5. Start server on port 3002, use `playwright-cli` to verify title, creation, HUD, combat, menus, dialogue, mobile layout; inspect screenshots and iterate.
6. Ensure save/load, quest progression, boss flow, creature capture, endings are actually playable end-to-end.
7. Add final `README.md` with setup, controls, features, limitations, and honest GOTY framing; optionally add font license files.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/core/Game.js`: missing; central state, scene loop, save, world orchestration, all methods referenced by UI.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/main.js`: missing; bootstraps Game/UI/audio.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui/EndScreens.js`: missing; required by `UI.js` import.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui/UI.js`: core UI/HUD/dialogue/minimap methods; references game methods and `EndScreens`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui/MenuScreen.js`: pause menu core tabs; imports `MenuExtra`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui/MenuExtra.js`: creatures/quests/map/settings/system/shop/help/credits methods.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui/CreationScreen.js`: character creation and preview draft.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/ui/TitleScreen.js`: title menu and callbacks.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/core/Quests.js`: quest state/events/rewards; requires game hooks `onQuestStep`, `onQuestComplete`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/core/stats.js`: attribute/derived-stat formulas.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/dialogues.js`: all NPC dialogue and boss/ending scripted scenes; uses `C(label,to,act)` and `N(text,extra)`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/zones.js`: zone terrain functions, layouts, NPCs, waypoints, portals, interactables, boss arenas.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/quests.js`: quest definitions and main order.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/enemies.js`: enemy definitions and spawns.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data/items.js`: items, equipment, classes, difficulties.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/audio/AudioEngine.js`: procedural music/SFX; needs `audio.sfx` calls wired.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/style.css`: all UI styling; any new screens must use existing classes or add CSS.

## Important Context
- `package.json` scripts: `npm run dev` on port 3002, `npm run build`, `npm run preview`.
- `start.sh` uses `${RUNTIME_DIR}/scripts/default-start.mjs`; it supports Vite projects and builds to `dist`.
- `capture.sh` uses Playwright with `CAPTURE_URL`/`CAPTURE_DIR`; auto-start only clicks controls labeled exactly “Start”/“Play”/“Start Game”/“Play Game”, so Spanish title buttons likely leave screenshots on title unless a custom selector is used.
- The app must build with `vite build --base ./`.
- `index.html` includes `#boot`, `#hud`, `#ui`, `#toast-layer`, `#cinematic`, `#subtitle`, `#skip-cinematic`, `#fade`, `#portrait-lock`.
- UI uses `game.zones` (all `ZONES`), `game.world.zone`, `game.world.enemies/npcs/waypoints/portals/interactables/creatureSpawns`, `game.quests`, `game.player.pos`, `game.player.mesh`, `game.zoneId`, `game.save`, `game.settings`.
- `game.save` expected fields: `name`, `className`, `appearance`, `stats`, `freePoints`, `level`, `xp`, `gold`, `essence`, `inventory`, `equipment`, `creatures[{id,level}]`, `activeCreature`, `flags`, `resonance`, `zone`, `position`, `discoveredWaypoints`, `playTime`, `difficulty`.
- `QuestManager` auto-completes talk objectives on `notifyTalk`; dialogue `wasJustCompleted` is checked by NPC dialogue roots.
- `SCRIPTED.ending` now calls `g.queueEnding('open'|'closed')`; Game must implement queueing then call `finishEnding` after dialogue closes.
- `SCRIPTED.varok_after` calls `g.spareVarok()` / `g.consumeVarok()` via choice actions; implement flags, resonance and post-boss quest flow.
- `MenuExtra` shop calls `game.buyItem(id)`; shop prices are internal in `SHOP`.
- `UI.getTerrainCanvas` uses raw hex bit-shift color conversion; no THREE import needed there.
- There is a known typo-fix already applied in items: key is `llave_ceniza`, not `llave_ ceniza`.
- Repo is uncommitted; no build has been run yet.
- `MenuExtra` imports unused symbols (`ATTRS`, `derive`, `xpForLevel`, `STAT_NAMES`, etc.) — harmless but can be cleaned.
- `CreationScreen` uses `structuredClone(this.draft)` (supported by modern browsers/Chromium).
- Font license attribution is mentioned in credits; actual OFL license files not yet added.
- `README.md` is still generic and needs replacing with game documentation.

Combate
275:

Pulsa atacar varias veces para encadenar un combo de tres golpes. El tercer golpe hace más daño y empuja. Esquivar consume aguante y te hace invulnerable durante un instante. Bloquear reduce el daño; si bloqueas justo en el momento del impacto, ejecutas un paro que aturde al enemigo y rellena aguante. La barra verde se agota: sin aguante no puedes esquivar ni bloquear.

276:

278:
Resonancia y criaturas
279:

Debilita a una criatura por debajo de un tercio de su vida y pulsa Capturar. La probabilidad depende de su vida restante, tu suerte y la rareza. Las criaturas capturadas luchan a tu lado: invoca una y usa su habilidad con F. La esencia de resonancia las fortalece.

281:
282:
Progresión
283:

Sube de nivel con experiencia, reparte puntos de atributo y equipa armas, armaduras, cascos y amuletos. Cada atributo tiene un efecto medible: vitalidad, maná, aguante, daño, defensa, velocidad, poder mágico, crítico y captura. Las misiones principales avanzan la historia; las secundarias dan equipo único y lore.

Mapa y viaje
287:

Descubre santuarios acercándote a ellos. Desde el mapa puedes viajar entre santuarios descubiertos de la región actual, siempre fuera de combate. Los portales conectan Valdoria, Drakmor y Kansordore cuando la historia lo permite.

## Objective
- Build “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL”, a real, playable, original action-fantasy RPG for Android/browser (horizontal, Spanish from Spain) with 3 regions, combat, exploration, creature collection, customizable protagonist, story, UI, audio and high production ambition; GOTY is an aspiration, never a claimed award.

## Requirements
- Must be a real playable game, not a demo/design document/mockup.
- Original universe, characters, creatures, story, music and art; no existing IP.
- Regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats (Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte) with measurable effects and equipment affecting appearance where viable.
- Mobile-first horizontal layout, usable touch controls, Android support; Spanish (Spain).
- Quality targets: gameplay, combat, story, characters, world, exploration, art, music/sound, animations, AI, UI, performance, accessibility, system depth, originality.
- Do not invent unsupported platform capabilities; explain limitations and provide best alternative.

## Decisions
- Build as a Vite + Three.js browser game with procedural 3D visuals, Web Audio music/SFX, Canvas UI/maps, localStorage saves.
- Use 3 separate zones loaded via portals rather than one continuous world.
- Stylized low-poly/toon 3D with procedural terrain, props, structures, characters and creatures to avoid external assets and licensing issues.
- Bundle fonts locally (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`) under `public/fonts`.
- Main systems: third-person camera, 3-hit melee combo, dodge i-frames, block/parry, stamina, two class skills, creature capture/summon/upgrade, equipment/attributes, quests/dialogues/choices, waypoints/fast travel, shop, accessibility, auto-save.
- Eight creatures: Lumifín, Bramiel, Grímpola, Brasal, Umbrino, Cineronte, Petreluz, Celemn.
- Three classes/juramentos: Guardián, Filo, Vidente.
- Main quest chain of 13 quests plus 5 side quests.
- Endings: open or close the Velo, with epilogue influenced by choices/resonance.
- UI orchestration split into multiple classes to avoid oversized single file.
- Settings/audio/menu from title use overlays; gameplay pause menu is a separate screen.
- Player/enemy/creature models built procedurally in `src/world/models.js`; visual equipment changes via mesh rebuild.
- Combat model: player melee arcs, enemy windup telegraphs, ranged projectiles, boss phases and telegraphed specials, creature ability mapping per creature id.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repo; it was essentially empty except agent scaffolding, `README.md`, `start.sh`, `capture.sh`.
- Created project scaffold: `package.json` (Three.js ^0.187.0, Vite ^8.3.5), `index.html`, favicon, local fonts.
- Downloaded and bundled `cinzel.woff2`, `cormorant.woff2`, `cormorant-italic.woff2` into `public/fonts`.
- Wrote full CSS design system and responsive/touch/UI styles in `src/style.css`.
- Implemented utilities: `src/utils/math.js`, `src/utils/noise.js`.
- Implemented data: items/equipment/classes/difficulties, creatures, enemies/spawns, quests, zones/terrain/layouts, dialogues including story scenes and endings.
- Implemented systems: `AudioEngine` (procedural adaptive music + SFX), `Save`, `Input` (keyboard/mouse/touch/gamepad), `QuestManager`, `stats.js`.
- Implemented UI core: boot, HUD, joystick/buttons, dialogue typewriter, minimap/full map, toasts, banners, target/boss bars, cinematic subtitles, damage numbers.

- Created `src/ui/EndScreens.js` with death, ending and credits screens.
- Created `src/core/Dialogue.js` interpreting NPC/scripted dialogue nodes, choices, actions, function transitions and close callbacks.

- Created `src/fx/Effects.js` with particle bursts, ground rings, slashes, beams, auras and projectiles.

117:     else {
118:       this.hp = Math.min(this.hp, base.hp)
119:       this.mp = Math.min(this.mp, base.mp)
120:       this.stamina = Math.min(this.stamina, base.stamina)
121:     }
122:     this.game.ui?.refreshHUD?.()

147:   update(dt) {
148:     if (this.dead) return
149:     const game = this.game
150:     if (game.state !== 'playing') { this.animate(dt, true); return }
151:     dt = Math.min(dt, .05)
152: 
153:     this.tickTimers(dt)
154:     this.updateEffects(dt)
155:     const input = game.input
156:     const axis = input.axis()
157:     const yaw = game.cameraYaw
158:     const forward = { x: -Math.sin(yaw), z: -Math.cos(yaw) }
159:     const right = { x: Math.cos(yaw), z: -Math.sin(yaw) }
160:     let mx = right.x * axis.x + forward.x * (-axis.y)
161:     let mz = right.z * axis.x + forward.z * (-axis.y)
162:     const mlen = Math.hypot(mx, mz)
163:     if (mlen > .01) { mx /= mlen; mz /= mlen }
164:     const moving = mlen > .05
165: 
166:     let speed = this.derived.speed
167:     if (this.blocking) speed *= .44
168:     if (this.attackTimer > 0) speed *= .16
169:     if (this.dodgeTime > 0) speed = 0
170: 
171:     if (this.dodgeTime > 0) {
172:       this.pos.x += this.dodgeDir.x * 13.5 * dt
173:       this.pos.z += this.dodgeDir.z * 13.5 * dt
174:       this.facing = Math.atan2(this.dodgeDir.x, this.dodgeDir.z)
175:     } else if (moving) {
176:       this.pos.x += mx * speed * dt
177:       this.pos.z += mz * speed * dt
178:       this.facing = dampAngle(this.facing, Math.atan2(mx, mz), 14, dt)
179:       this.moveSpeed = speed
180:     } else {
181:       this.moveSpeed = 0
182:       if (this.attackTimer > 0) this.facing = dampAngle(this.facing, yaw + Math.PI, 16, dt)
183:     }
184: 
185:     this.clampPosition()
186:     const zone = game.world?.zone
187:     const ground = zone ? zone.heightAt(this.pos.x, this.pos.z) : 0
188:     this.pos.y = ground + .03
189:     this.mesh.position.copy(this.pos)
190:     this.mesh.rotation.y = this.facing
191: 
192:     // Animación de ataque
193:     if (this.attackTimer > 0) {
194:       this.attackTimer -= dt
195:       const spent = (this.comboIndex === 2 ? .46 : .34) - this.attackTimer
196:       if (!this.attackDidHit && spent >= this.attackHitAt) {
197:         this.attackDidHit = true
198:         this.performHit()
199:       }
200:       if (this.attackTimer <= 0) {
201:         this.attackTimer = 0
202:         if (this.comboQueued && this.comboIndex < 2) this.startAttack(true)
203:         else this.attackCD = .08
204:       }
205:     } else if (this.comboTimer > 0) {
206:       this.comboTimer -= dt
207:       if (this.comboTimer <= 0) this.comboIndex = 0
208:     }
209: 
210:     if (this.blocking && this.parryReady > 0) this.parryReady -= dt
211:     if (this.iFrames > 0) this.iFrames -= dt
212:     if (this.dodgeTime > 0) {
213:       this.dodgeTime -= dt
214:       if (this.dodgeTime <= 0) this.dodgeTime = 0
215:     }
216: 
217:     // Regeneración
218:     this.outOfCombat += dt
219:     if (this.outOfCombat > 4.5) {
220:       this.hp = Math.min(this.derived.hp, this.hp + this.derived.hpRegen * dt)
221:       const regen = this.passiveMods().regen + (this.save.activeCreature === 'lumifin' ? 2 : 0)
222:       if (regen) this.hp = Math.min(this.derived.hp, this.hp + regen * dt)
223:     }
224:     this.mp = Math.min(this.derived.mp, this.mp + this.derived.manaRegen * dt)
225:     this.stamina = Math.min(this.derived.stamina, this.stamina + this.derived.staminaRegen * (this.blocking ? .18 : 1) * dt)
226: 
227:     this.updateCompanion(dt)
228:     this.updateAura()
229:     this.updateCaptureTarget()
230:     this.updateBrasalAura(dt)
231:     this.animate(dt)
232:   }

234:   tickTimers(dt) {
235:     for (const k of Object.keys(this.cooldowns)) this.cooldowns[k] = Math.max(0, this.cooldowns[k] - dt)
236:     if (this.attackCD > 0) this.attackCD -= dt

239:   updateEffects(dt) {
240:     for (let i = this.effects.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
241:       const e = this.effects[i]
242:       e.time -= dt
243:       if (e.time <= 0) {
244:         if (e.id === 'shield') this.shield = 0
245:         this.effects.splice(i, 1)
246:       }
247:     }

250:   clampPosition() {
251:     const world = this.game.world
252:     if (!world) return
253:     const zone = world.zone
254:     const b = zone.bounds - 4
255:     this.pos.x = clamp(this.pos.x, -b, b)
256:     this.pos.z = clamp(this.pos.z, -b, b)
257:     if (zone.isWater?.(this.pos.x, this.pos.z)) {
258:       const h = zone.heightAt(this.pos.x, this.pos.z)
259:       if (h < (zone.id === 'drakmor' ? -1.8 : -2.5)) {
260:         this.pos.x -= this.velocity.x * .01
261:         this.pos.z -= this.velocity.z * .01
262:       }
263:     }
264:     const c = world.resolveCollision?.(this.pos.x, this.pos.z, .55)
265:     if (c) { this.pos.x = c.x; this.pos.z = c.z }
266:     if (world.bossArenaLock) {
267:       const a = world.bossArenaLock
268:       const d = Math.hypot(this.pos.x - a.x, this.pos.z - a.z)
269:       if (d > a.radius) {
270:         const k = a.radius / d
271:         this.pos.x = a.x + (this.pos.x - a.x) * k
272:         this.pos.z = a.z + (this.pos.z - a.z) * k
273:       }
274:     }
275:   }

277:   updateCaptureTarget() {

279:     if (!this.game.world) return
280:     let best = null, bestD = 8

282:       if (c.caught || c.dead) continue
283:       const d = Math.hypot(c.pos.x - this.pos.x, c.pos.z - this.pos.z)
284:       if (d < bestD && c.hp / c.maxHp <= .45) { best = c; bestD = d }
285:     }
286:     this.captureTarget = best
287:   }

289:   updateCompanion(dt) {
290:     if (!this.companion) return
291:     const t = performance.now() * .001
292:     const side = Math.sin(t * .7 + this.companion.userData.phase) * .45
293:     const targetX = this.pos.x + Math.cos(this.facing) * this.companionOffset.z + Math.sin(this.facing) * (1.2 + side)
294:     const targetZ = this.pos.z - Math.sin(this.facing) * this.companionOffset.z + Math.cos(this.facing) * (1.2 + side)
295:     const ground = this.game.world?.zone?.heightAt(targetX, targetZ) ?? 0
296:     const targetY = ground + 1.15 + Math.sin(t * 2.2 + (this.companion.userData.phase || 0)) * .12
297:     this.companion.position.x += (targetX - this.companion.position.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.4)
298:     this.companion.position.z += (targetZ - this.companion.position.z) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.4)
299:     this.companion.position.y += (targetY - this.companion.position.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 4.2)
300:     this.companion.rotation.y = dampAngle(this.companion.rotation.y, this.facing, 6, dt)
301:     const rig = this.companion.userData.rig
302:     if (rig?.wings) rig.wings.forEach((w, i) => { w.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 8 + i * Math.PI) * .35 })
303:     if (rig?.body) rig.body.position.y = Math.sin(t * 2.4) * .04
304:   }

332:     this.walkPhase += dt * (2.4 + speed * .72)
333:     const swing = Math.sin(this.walkPhase) * Math.min(.75, speed * .07)
334:     const bob = Math.abs(Math.sin(this.walkPhase * 2)) * Math.min(.06, speed * .006)
335:     rig.body.position.y = bob + (this.dead ? -.35 : 0)
336:     rig.legL.rotation.x = swing
337:     rig.legR.rotation.x = -swing
338:     rig.armL.rotation.x = -swing * .7
339:     rig.armR.rotation.x = swing * .35
340:     rig.armL.rotation.z = -.08
341:     rig.armR.rotation.z = .08
342:     rig.body.rotation.z = this.dodgeTime > 0 ? .25 : 0
343:     rig.head.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * .7) * .04
344:     rig.head.rotation.x = this.blocking ? .12 : 0
345: 
346:     if (this.attackTimer > 0) {

352:       rig.armR.rotation.x = ang
353:       rig.armR.rotation.z = -.45 + Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * .9

358:     if (this.blocking) {

363:     if (this.hurtFlash > 0) {

365:       this.mesh.traverse(o => { if (o.material?.emissive) o.material.emissive.setHex(0x6a1a14) })

381:   startAttack(queued = false) {
382:     if (this.dead || this.attackCD > 0 || this.attackTimer > 0) return
383:     if (this.stamina < 5) { this.game.toast('Sin aguante para atacar.', '⚠'); return }
384:     if (!queued) {
385:       if (this.comboTimer > 0) this.comboIndex = (this.comboIndex + 1) % 3
386:       else this.comboIndex = 0
387:     } else this.comboIndex++
388:     this.stamina -= 5
389:     this.attackTimer = this.comboIndex === 2 ? .46 : .34
390:     this.attackHitAt = this.comboIndex === 2 ? .22 : .13
391:     this.attackDidHit = false
392:     this.comboQueued = false
393:     this.comboTimer = .9
394:     this.outOfCombat = 0

399:   queueCombo() {

404:     return false

407:   performHit() {
408:     const game = this.game
409:     const reach = this.comboIndex === 2 ? 3.1 : 2.45
410:     const arc = this.comboIndex === 2 ? Math.PI * .9 : Math.PI * .62
411:     const dmgBase = this.derived.attack * (this.comboIndex === 2 ? 1.85 : this.comboIndex === 1 ? 1.12 : 1)
412:     const origin = new THREE.Vector3(this.pos.x, this.pos.y + 1, this.pos.z)
413:     const dir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(this.facing), 0, Math.cos(this.facing))
414:     game.fx.slash(this.pos, this.facing, this.comboIndex === 2 ? 0xffc46a : 0xffe6c0, this.comboIndex === 2 ? 2 : 1.45)
415:     let hits = 0
416:     for (const enemy of game.world?.enemies || []) {
417:       if (!enemy.alive) continue
418:       const to = new THREE.Vector3(enemy.pos.x - this.pos.x, 0, enemy.pos.z - this.pos.z)
419:       const d = to.length()
420:       if (d > reach + enemy.def.radius) continue
421:       to.normalize()
422:       const dot = dir.dot(to)
423:       if (dot < Math.cos(arc / 2)) continue
424:       const crit = Math.random() < this.derived.crit
425:       let dmg = dmgBase * (crit ? this.derived.critMult : 1) * (0.93 + Math.random() * .14)
426:       if (enemy.def.boss) dmg *= .92
427:       enemy.takeDamage(Math.round(dmg), { crit, source: 'player', dir: to.clone(), combo: this.comboIndex })
428:       hits++
429:     }
430:     if (hits) {
431:       this.outOfCombat = 0
432:       game.hitStop = Math.max(game.hitStop, this.comboIndex === 2 ? .11 : .055)
433:       game.shakeCamera?.(this.comboIndex === 2 ? .24 : .12, .18)
434:       game.audio?.sfx('hit')
435:       if (this.comboIndex === 2) game.fx.ring(new THREE.Vector3(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, this.pos.z), 0xffd28a, 2.8, { life: .45 })
436:     }
437:   }

439:   dodge() {

441:     const axis = this.game.input.axis()
442:     let dx = 0, dz = 0
443:     if (Math.abs(axis.x) + Math.abs(axis.y) > .1) {
444:       const yaw = this.game.cameraYaw
445:       const forward = { x: -Math.sin(yaw), z: -Math.cos(yaw) }
446:       const right = { x: Math.cos(yaw), z: -Math.sin(yaw) }
447:       dx = right.x * axis.x + forward.x * (-axis.y)
448:       dz = right.z * axis.x + forward.z * (-axis.y)
449:     } else {
450:       dx = Math.sin(this.facing); dz = Math.cos(this.facing)
451:     }
452:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1
453:     this.dodgeDir.set(dx / len, 0, dz / len)
454:     this.stamina -= this.derived.dodgeCost
455:     this.dodgeTime = .28
456:     this.iFrames = .34

458:     this.game.audio?.sfx('dodge')

558:     this.creatureCooldown = this.cooldowns.creature

275:

Bloquear reduce el daño; si bloqueas justo en el momento del impacto, ejecutas un paro que aturde al enemigo y rellena aguante. La barra verde se agota: sin aguante no puedes esquivar ni bloquear.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

## Objective
- Build “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL”, a real, playable, original action-fantasy RPG for Android/browser (horizontal, Spanish from Spain) with 3 regions, combat, exploration, creature collection, customizable protagonist, story, UI, audio and high production ambition; GOTY is an aspiration, never a claimed award.

## Requirements
- Must be a real playable game, not a demo/design document/mockup.
- Original universe, characters, creatures, story, music and art; no existing IP.
- Regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats (Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte) with measurable effects and equipment affecting appearance where viable.
- Mobile-first horizontal layout, usable touch controls, Android support; Spanish (Spain).
- Quality targets: gameplay, combat, story, characters, world, exploration, art, music/sound, animations, AI, UI, performance, accessibility, system depth, originality.
- Do not invent unsupported platform capabilities; explain limitations and provide best alternative.

## Decisions
- Build as a Vite + Three.js browser game with procedural 3D visuals, Web Audio music/SFX, Canvas UI/maps, localStorage saves.
- Use 3 separate zones loaded via portals rather than one continuous world.
- Stylized low-poly/toon 3D with procedural terrain, props, structures, characters and creatures to avoid external assets and licensing issues.
- Bundle fonts locally (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`) under `public/fonts`.
- Main systems: third-person camera, 3-hit melee combo, dodge i-frames, block/parry, stamina, two class skills, creature capture/summon/upgrade, equipment/attributes, quests/dialogues/choices, waypoints/fast travel, shop, accessibility, auto-save.
- Eight creatures: Lumifín, Bramiel, Grímpola, Brasal, Umbrino, Cineronte, Petreluz, Celemn.
- Three classes/juramentos: Guardián, Filo, Vidente.
- Main quest chain of 13 quests plus 5 side quests.
- Endings: open or close the Velo, with epilogue influenced by choices/resonance.
- UI orchestration split into multiple classes to avoid oversized single file.
- Settings/audio/menu from title use overlays; gameplay pause menu is a separate screen.
- Player/enemy/creature models built procedurally in `src/world/models.js`; visual equipment changes via mesh rebuild.
- Combat model: player melee arcs, enemy windup telegraphs, ranged projectiles, boss phases and telegraphed specials, creature ability mapping per creature id.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repo; it was essentially empty except agent scaffolding, `README.md`, `start.sh`, `capture.sh`.
- Created project scaffold: `package.json` (Three.js ^0.187.0, Vite ^8.3.5), `index.html`, favicon, local fonts.
- Downloaded and bundled `cinzel.woff2`, `cormorant.woff2`, `cormorant-italic.woff2` into `public/fonts`.
- Wrote full CSS design system and responsive/touch/UI styles in `src/style.css`.
- Implemented utilities: `src/utils/math.js`, `src/utils/noise.js`.
- Implemented data: items/equipment/classes/difficulties, creatures, enemies/spawns, quests, zones/terrain/layouts, dialogues including story scenes and endings.
- Implemented systems: `AudioEngine` (procedural adaptive music + SFX), `Save`, `Input` (keyboard/mouse/touch/gamepad), `QuestManager`, `stats.js`.
- Implemented UI core: boot, HUD, joystick/buttons, dialogue typewriter, minimap/full map, toasts, banners, target/boss bars, cinematic subtitles, damage numbers.
- Implemented `TitleScreen`, `CreationScreen`, `MenuScreen` core tabs (personaje/equipo/inventario), `MenuExtra` (criaturas/misiones/mapa/ajustes/sistema/shop/help/credits).
- Wrote procedural SVG portraits in `src/ui/portraits.js`.
- Created `src/ui/EndScreens.js` with death, ending and credits screens.
- Created `src/core/Dialogue.js` interpreting NPC/scripted dialogue nodes, choices, actions, function transitions and close callbacks.
- Created `src/world/models.js` with procedural humanoid, enemy, creature, sword, name-tag and glow model factories.
- Created `src/fx/Effects.js` with particle bursts, ground rings, slashes, beams, auras and projectiles.
- Created `src/entities/Player.js` with movement/camera-relative control, combo attacks, dodge i-frames, block/parry, class skills, creature abilities/passives, potions, capture targeting, status effects, death and procedural animations.
- Created `src/entities/Enemy.js` with idle/chase/return AI, windup attacks, ranged/fan projectiles, boss phases, specials, stuns, slows, burn, knockback, loot/death hooks and animation.
- Ran `npm install` successfully (Three.js + Vite installed).
- Created `src/entities/Creature.js`: wild creature wander/flee behavior, HP/damage, capture state, respawn, name tags, motes, death/removal.
- Created `src/entities/NPC.js`: procedural NPC model, role styling, name tag, idle animation, player-facing behavior.
- Created `src/world/World.js`: sky shader, lights, fog, terrain vertex colors, water/lava/cloud planes, instanced trees/rocks/grass/flowers/crystals, zone-specific villages/ruins/camps/fortress/sanctuary/beacon/library/city/temple/altar, waypoints, portals, interactables, NPC/creature/enemy spawning, boss spawn, collision resolution, focus prompts, discovery, respawns, ambient animation and disposal.

### Active
- Need to create `src/core/Game.js` implementing all UI/quest/dialogue hooks and end-to-end flow.
- Need to create `src/main.js` bootstrapping `Game` and UI/audio.
- Need to run build and fix syntax/module/reference errors across new modules.
- Need to start server on port 3002 and use Playwright to verify title, creation, HUD, combat, menus, dialogue, mobile layout.
- Need to verify save/load, quest progression, boss flow, creature capture, endings end-to-end.
- Need to fix known pending UI/data issues below.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Create `src/core/Game.js`: renderer/camera/loop, title/creation scenes, save/load, zone loading/transitions, quest hooks, dialogue flow, interactions, combat orchestration, bosses, shop, settings, endings, retry/death, auto-save.
2. Create `src/main.js` bootstrapping `Game` and UI/audio.
3. Wire all missing methods referenced by UI/data: `game.openMenu`, `closeMenu`, `beginCharacterCreation`, `setCreationPreview`, `rotateCreationPreview`, `startNewGame`, `continueGame`, `returnToTitle`, `saveSummary`, `quests`, `world`, `zones`, `player`, `save`, `inventoryCount`, `addItem`, `useItem`, `equipItem`, `spendAttribute`, `summonCreature`, `upgradeCreature`, `buyItem`, `fastTravel`, `isWaypointDiscovered`, `openShop/closeShop`, `startBossFight`, `spareVarok`, `consumeVarok`, `queueEnding`, `finishEnding`, `applySettings`, `autoSave`, `saveGame`, `loadGameFromMenu`, `resetSave`, `cameraYaw`, `skipCinematic`, `projectPoint`, `shakeCamera`, `hitStop`, `difficulty`, `onQuestStep`, `onQuestComplete`, `onDialogueClosed`, `onEnemyDeath`, `onPlayerDeath`, `retryFromCheckpoint`, `resumeAfterEnding`, `tryCapture`, `usePotion`, `removeItem`, `addXP`, `addGold`, `addResonance`, `toast`, `setDifficulty`.
4. Add UI missing helpers: `refreshHUD()` and `captureFlash()`; fix `UI.openSettings(from)` to pass `from === 'title'`.
5. Fix `TitleScreen` “Nueva partida” to include “Start Game” in aria-label for `capture.sh` auto-start.
6. Fix `MenuExtra` help/credits close handlers from title (currently calls `ui.showTitle`, duplicating title); add missing `difficulty` action handler in `MenuScreen`; ensure settings render with no save.
7. Add `despertar.next = 'sombras_ribera'` so declining “prepare” does not dead-end the main quest.
8. Patch `Player` to include class bonuses in `derive`/`recalc` and allow melee/skills to damage `world.creatureSpawns`.
9. Run `npm run build`, fix errors, then `npm run dev`/`npm run preview` on 3002 and Playwright verify screenshots and interactions.
10. End-to-end test quest chain, boss fights, capture, save/load, both endings, mobile landscape.
11. Replace `README.md` with real game documentation, setup, controls, features, Android/browser limitations, honest GOTY framing; add font OFL license files.
12. Commit work when complete (repo currently uncommitted).

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/core/Game.js`: missing; central state, renderer/loop, save, world orchestration, all UI/quest hooks.

## Important Context
- `package.json` scripts: `npm run dev` on port 3002, `npm run build` (`vite build --base ./`), `npm run preview`.

104:     new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
105:       uniforms,
106:       side: THREE.BackSide,
107:       depthWrite: false,
108:       vertexShader: `
109:         varying vec3 vWorld;
110:         void main() {
111:           vec4 world = modelMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
112:           vWorld = world.xyz;
113:           gl_Position = projectionMatrix * modelViewMatrix * vec4(position, 1.0);
114:         }`,
115:       fragmentShader: `
116:         uniform vec3 topColor;
117:         uniform vec3 bottomColor;
118:         uniform float offset;
119:         uniform float exponent;
120:         varying vec3 vWorld;
121:         void main() {
122:           float h = normalize(vWorld + vec3(0.0, offset, 0.0)).y;
123:           float t = pow(max(h * 0.5 + 0.5, 0.0), exponent);
124:           gl_FragColor = vec4(mix(bottomColor, topColor, t), 1.0);
125:         }`
126:     })
127:   )
128:   sky.frustumCulled = false
129:   scene.add(sky)
130: 
131:   const sunTex = makeSunTexture()
132:   const sun = new THREE.Sprite(new THREE.SpriteMaterial({
133:     map: sunTex, color: palette.sun, transparent: true, opacity: .9,
134:     depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending
135:   }))
136:   sun.scale.set(38, 38, 1)
137:   sun.position.fromArray(palette.sunPos)
138:   if (sun.position.length() > radius * .85) sun.position.normalize().multiplyScalar(radius * .82)
139:   scene.add(sun)
140: 
141:   scene.background = new THREE.Color(palette.skyBottom)
142:   scene.fog = new THREE.FogExp2(palette.fog, palette.fogDensity)
143:   return { sky, sun, sunTex }
144: }

146: export function buildLights(scene, palette, shadows = true) {
147:   const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(palette.hemiSky, palette.hemiGround, palette.hemiIntensity)
148:   scene.add(hemi)
149:   const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(palette.ambient, .55)
150:   scene.add(ambient)
151:   const dir = new THREE.DirectionalLight(palette.sun, 2.1)
152:   dir.position.fromArray(palette.sunPos)
153:   dir.castShadow = shadows
154:   if (shadows) {
155:     dir.shadow.mapSize.set(2048, 2048)
156:     dir.shadow.camera.near = 1
157:     dir.shadow.camera.far = 220
158:     dir.shadow.camera.left = -70
159:     dir.shadow.camera.right = 70
160:     dir.shadow.camera.top = 70
161:     dir.shadow.camera.bottom = -70
162:     dir.shadow.bias = -.0007
163:     dir.shadow.normalBias = .03
164:   }
165:   scene.add(dir)
166:   const target = new THREE.Object3D()
167:   target.position.set(0, 0, 0)
168:   scene.add(target)
169:   dir.target = target
170:   return { hemi, ambient, dir, target }
171: }

173: export class World {

175:     this.game = game
176:     this.zoneId = zoneId
177:     this.zone = ZONES[zoneId]

179:     this.group = new THREE.Group()
180:     this.group.name = `world-${zoneId}`
181:     game.scene.add(this.group)
182: 
183:     this.time = 0
184:     this.quality = game.settings.quality
185:     this.enemies = []

187:     this.respawnQueue = []
188:     this.creatureSpawns = []
189:     this.npcs = []

193:     this.colliders = []

196:     this.floaters = []
197:     this.spinners = []
198:     this.focus = null
199:     this.bossArenaLock = null
200:     this.gotoTimer = 0
201:     this.rand = rng(zoneId.split('').reduce((a, c) => a + c.charCodeAt(0), 17))
202: 
203:     this.buildEnvironment()
204:     this.buildTerrain()
205:     this.buildLandmarks()
206:     this.buildWaypoints()
207:     this.buildPortals()
208:     this.buildInteractables()

216:   // ───────────────────────────── Entorno ─────────────────────────────
217:   buildEnvironment() {
218:     const p = this.zone.palette
219:     this.sky = buildSky(this.game.scene, p)
220:     this.lights = buildLights(this.game.scene, p, this.quality !== 'baja' && this.quality !== 'baja')
221:     this.buildDistantLandscape()
222:     this.buildWater()
223:   }
224: 
225:   buildDistantLandscape() {
226:     const p = this.zone.palette
227:     const b = this.zone.bounds
228:     const r = this.rand
229:     const material = std(this.zoneId === 'drakmor' ? 0x2c2326 : this.zoneId === 'kansordore' ? 0x59627e : 0x33473d, { roughness: 1 })
230:     for (let i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
231:       const a = (i / 26) * TAU + r() * .12
232:       const dist = b + 26 + r() * 55
233:       const h = 8 + r() * 27
234:       const m = cone(7 + r() * 9, h, 5, material, Math.cos(a) * dist, -4 + h / 2, Math.sin(a) * dist)
235:       m.castShadow = false
236:       this.group.add(m)
237:       if (this.zoneId === 'kansordore' && i % 3 === 0) {
238:         const isle = new THREE.Group()
239:         isle.position.set(Math.cos(a) * (b + 5 + r() * 18), 9 + r() * 12, Math.sin(a) * (b + 5 + r() * 18))
240:         isle.add(cyl(2.4 + r() * 2.4, 1.1, 1.2, 6, std(0x7e849c), 0, 0, 0))
241:         isle.add(cone(1.1, 2.8, 5, std(0x9aa0b4), 0, -1.7, 0))
242:         isle.add(sphere(1.4, std(0x6d7f8f, { emissive: p.accent, emissiveIntensity: .08 }), 0, 1.2, 0, 6))
243:         isle.userData.baseY = isle.position.y
244:         isle.userData.speed = .3 + r() * .4
245:         this.group.add(isle)
246:         this.floaters.push(isle)
247:       }
248:     }
249:   }
250: 
251:   buildWater() {
252:     const p = this.zone.palette
253:     const size = this.zone.bounds * 2.4
254:     const isLava = this.zoneId === 'drakmor'
255:     const y = isLava ? -2.35 : this.zoneId === 'kansordore' ? -3.6 : -2.55
256:     const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
257:       color: p.water,
258:       roughness: isLava ? .4 : .22,
259:       metalness: isLava ? .1 : .35,
260:       transparent: true,
261:       opacity: isLava ? .96 : this.zoneId === 'kansordore' ? .5 : .84,
262:       emissive: isLava ? p.water : 0x000000,
263:       emissiveIntensity: isLava ? .42 : 0
264:     })
265:     const water = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size, size, 1, 1), mat)
266:     water.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
267:     water.position.y = y
268:     water.receiveShadow = false
269:     this.group.add(water)
270:     this.water = water
271:     if (this.zoneId === 'kansordore') {
272:       const cloud = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size * 2, size * 2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({
273:         color: 0xdce8ff, transparent: true, opacity: .18, depthWrite: false
274:       }))
275:       cloud.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2
276:       cloud.position.y = y - 1.4
277:       this.group.add(cloud)
278:       this.cloudSea = cloud
279:     }
280:   }
281: 
282:   buildTerrain() {
283:     const zone = this.zone
284:     const size = zone.bounds * 2
285:     const seg = this.quality === 'alta' ? 160 : this.quality === 'media' ? 120 : this.quality === 'baja' ? 78 : 136
286:     const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size, size, seg, seg)
287:     geo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2)
288:     const pos = geo.attributes.position
289:     const colors = []
290:     const cGround = new THREE.Color(zone.palette.ground)
291:     const cGround2 = new THREE.Color(zone.palette.ground2)
292:     const cRock = new THREE.Color(zone.palette.rock)
293:     const cWater = new THREE.Color(zone.palette.water)
294:     const tmp = new THREE.Color()
295:     for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
296:       const x = pos.getX(i), z = pos.getZ(i)
297:       const h = zone.heightAt(x, z)
298:       pos.setY(i, h)
299:       const alt = clamp((h + 2) / 14, 0, 1)
300:       tmp.copy(cGround).lerp(cGround2, alt)
301:       if (h > 5.5) tmp.lerp(cRock, clamp((h - 5.5) / 8, 0, .7))
302:       if (zone.isWater?.(x, z) && h < -1.1) tmp.lerp(cWater, .65)
303:       const variation = .88 + (Math.sin(x * 1.7 + z * 2.3) * .5 + .5) * .2
304:       tmp.multiplyScalar(variation)
305:       colors.push(tmp.r, tmp.g, tmp.b)
306:     }
307:     geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3))
308:     geo.computeVertexNormals()
309:     const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
310:       vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, metalness: 0, flatShading: true
311:     })
312:     const terrain = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)
313:     terrain.receiveShadow = true
314:     this.group.add(terrain)
315:     this.terrain = terrain
316:   }
317: 
318:   buildMotes() {
319:     const p = this.zone.palette
320:     const count = this.zoneId === 'drakmor' ? 260 : 200
321:     const positions = new Float32Array(count * 3)
322:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
323:       const a = Math.random() * TAU, r = Math.random() * 52
324:       positions[i * 3] = Math.cos(a) * r
325:       positions[i * 3 + 1] = 1.2 + Math.random() * 16
326:       positions[i * 3 + 2] = Math.sin(a) * r
327:     }
328:     const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
329:     geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
330:     const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
331:       color: p.particle, size: this.zoneId === 'drakmor' ? .16 : .1,
332:       transparent: true, opacity: .55, depthWrite: false,
333:       blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, sizeAttenuation: true
334:     })
335:     this.motes = new THREE.Points(geo, mat)
336:     this.motes.frustumCulled = false
337:     this.game.scene.add(this.motes)
338:   }

340:   // ───────────────────────────── Utilidades ─────────────────────────────
341:   reserve(x, z, radius = 3) { this.reserved.push({ x, z, r: radius }) }
342: 
343:   isReserved(x, z, pad = 0) {
344:     for (const r of this.reserved) if (Math.hypot(x - r.x, z - r.z) < r.r + pad) return true
345:     return false
346:   }
347: 
348:   addCollider(x, z, radius) { this.colliders.push({ x, z, r: radius }) }
349: 
350:   isWaterDeep(x, z) {
351:     return this.zone.isWater?.(x, z) && this.zone.heightAt(x, z) < (this.zoneId === 'drakmor' ? -1.9 : -2.3)
352:   }

354:   // ───────────────────────────── Arquitectura ─────────────────────────────
355:   buildLandmarks() {
356:     for (const lm of this.zone.landmarks) this.reserve(lm.pos[0], lm.pos[1], 8)
357:     for (const npc of this.zone.npcs) this.reserve(npc.pos[0], npc.pos[1], 2.5)
358:     for (const wp of this.zone.waypoints) this.reserve(wp.pos[0], wp.pos[1], 3)
359:     for (const portal of this.zone.portals) this.reserve(portal.pos[0], portal.pos[1], 4)
360:     for (const it of this.zone.interactables) this.reserve(it.pos[0], it.pos[1], 2)
361:     for (const arena of Object.values(this.zone.bossArenas || {})) this.reserve(arena.pos[0], arena.pos[1], arena.radius * .55)
362: 
363:     if (this.zoneId === 'valdoria') this.buildValdoria()
364:     else if (this.zoneId === 'drakmor') this.buildDrakmor()
365:     else this.buildKansordore()
366:   }

778:   // ───────────────────────────── Vegetación y detalles ─────────────────────────────
779:   buildProps() {
780:     const props = this.zone.props
781:     const p = this.zone.palette
782:     let treeCount = props.treeCount
783:     let rockCount = props.rockCount
784:     let flowerCount = props.flowerCount
785:     let grassCount = props.grassCount
786:     if (this.quality === 'baja') { treeCount = Math.round(treeCount * .6); grassCount = Math.round(grassCount * .4); flowerCount = Math.round(flowerCount * .5) }
787:     if (this.quality === 'media') { treeCount = Math.round(treeCount * .8); grassCount = Math.round(grassCount * .75) }
788: 
789:     // Árboles: tronco y copa instanciados
790:     const style = props.treeStyle
791:     const trunkMat = std(style === 'dead' ? 0x3d302b : style === 'celestial' ? 0x8b899c : 0x5a4028, { roughness: .95 })
792:     const leafMat = style === 'dead'
793:       ? std(0x3a2f2c)
794:       : style === 'celestial'
795:         ? std(0x8fc5cf, { emissive: p.accent, emissiveIntensity: .13 })
796:         : std(p.ground2, { roughness: .95 })
797:     const trunkGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.16, .28, 2.8, 5)
798:     const leafGeo = style === 'dead' ? new THREE.ConeGeometry(.9, 2.2, 4) : new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1.55, 0)
799:     const trunks = new THREE.InstancedMesh(trunkGeo, trunkMat, treeCount)
800:     const leaves = new THREE.InstancedMesh(leafGeo, leafMat, treeCount)
801:     trunks.castShadow = leaves.castShadow = this.quality !== 'baja'
802:     trunks.receiveShadow = leaves.receiveShadow = true
803:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
804:     let ti = 0
805:     let tries = 0
806:     while (ti < treeCount && tries < treeCount * 14) {
807:       tries++
808:       const x = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.84
809:       const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.84
810:       if (this.isReserved(x, z, 1.5) || this.isWaterDeep(x, z)) continue
811:       const h = this.zone.heightAt(x, z)
812:       if (h > 11) continue
813:       const s = .75 + this.rand() * .85
814:       dummy.position.set(x, h + 1.4 * s, z)
815:       dummy.rotation.y = this.rand() * TAU
816:       dummy.scale.set(s * (.8 + this.rand() * .3), s, s * (.8 + this.rand() * .3))
817:       dummy.updateMatrix()
818:       trunks.setMatrixAt(ti, dummy.matrix)
819:       dummy.position.y = h + (style === 'dead' ? 2.8 : 2.9) * s
820:       dummy.rotation.z = style === 'dead' ? (this.rand() - .5) * .3 : 0
821:       dummy.updateMatrix()
822:       leaves.setMatrixAt(ti, dummy.matrix)
823:       ti++
824:     }
825:     trunks.count = leaves.count = ti
826:     this.group.add(trunks, leaves)
827:     this.treeMeshes = [trunks, leaves]
828: 
829:     // Rocas
830:     const rockGeo = new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(.8, 0)
831:     const rockMat = std(p.rock, { roughness: 1 })
832:     const rocks = new THREE.InstancedMesh(rockGeo, rockMat, rockCount)
833:     rocks.castShadow = rocks.receiveShadow = this.quality !== 'baja'
834:     let ri = 0
835:     tries = 0
836:     while (ri < rockCount && tries < rockCount * 12) {
837:       tries++
838:       const x = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.8
839:       const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.8
840:       if (this.isReserved(x, z, 1) || this.isWaterDeep(x, z)) continue
841:       const s = .5 + this.rand() * 1.8
842:       dummy.position.set(x, this.zone.heightAt(x, z) + s * .22, z)
843:       dummy.rotation.set(this.rand() * TAU, this.rand() * TAU, this.rand() * TAU)
844:       dummy.scale.set(s, s * (.55 + this.rand() * .5), s)
845:       dummy.updateMatrix()
846:       rocks.setMatrixAt(ri, dummy.matrix)
847:       ri++
848:     }
849:     rocks.count = ri
850:     this.group.add(rocks)
851: 
852:     // Hierba
853:     if (grassCount > 0) {
854:       const grassGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(.16, .5)
855:       grassGeo.translate(0, .25, 0)
856:       const grassMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
857:         color: this.zoneId === 'drakmor' ? 0x4a3a2d : this.zoneId === 'kansordore' ? 0x7f8e91 : 0x5f7a45,
858:         roughness: 1, side: THREE.DoubleSide
859:       })
860:       const grass = new THREE.InstancedMesh(grassGeo, grassMat, grassCount)
861:       let gi = 0
862:       tries = 0
863:       while (gi < grassCount && tries < grassCount * 10) {
864:         tries++
865:         const x = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.9
866:         const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.9
867:         if (this.isReserved(x, z, .5) || this.isWaterDeep(x, z)) continue
868:         dummy.position.set(x, this.zone.heightAt(x, z), z)
869:         dummy.rotation.set(0, this.rand() * TAU, (this.rand() - .5) * .12)
870:         dummy.scale.setScalar(.7 + this.rand() * .8)
871:         dummy.updateMatrix()
872:         grass.setMatrixAt(gi, dummy.matrix)
873:         gi++
874:       }
875:       grass.count = gi
876:       grass.receiveShadow = true
877:       this.group.add(grass)
878:     }
879: 
880:     // Flores / motas de luz
881:     if (flowerCount > 0) {
882:       const positions = new Float32Array(flowerCount * 3)
883:       const cols = new Float32Array(flowerCount * 3)
884:       const col = new THREE.Color(p.particle)
885:       let fi = 0
886:       tries = 0
887:       while (fi < flowerCount && tries < flowerCount * 10) {
888:         tries++
889:         const x = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.8
890:         const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.8
891:         if (this.isReserved(x, z, .6) || this.isWaterDeep(x, z)) continue
892:         positions[fi * 3] = x
893:         positions[fi * 3 + 1] = this.zone.heightAt(x, z) + .25
894:         positions[fi * 3 + 2] = z
895:         cols[fi * 3] = col.r; cols[fi * 3 + 1] = col.g; cols[fi * 3 + 2] = col.b
896:         fi++
897:       }
898:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
899:       geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
900:       geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(cols, 3))
901:       const flowers = new THREE.Points(geo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({
902:         size: .19, vertexColors: true, transparent: true, opacity: .9,
903:         depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending
904:       }))
905:       flowers.count = fi
906:       this.group.add(flowers)
907:     }
908: 
909:     // Cristales
910:     if (props.crystals > 0) {
911:       const geo = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(.55, 0)
912:       geo.scale(.55, 1.4, .55)
913:       const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
914:         color: this.zoneId === 'drakmor' ? 0x5d2b25 : 0x7d9db7,
915:         emissive: p.accent, emissiveIntensity: this.zoneId === 'drakmor' ? .4 : .22,
916:         roughness: .3, metalness: .4, flatShading: true
917:       })
918:       const crystals = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, props.crystals)
919:       let ci = 0
920:       tries = 0
921:       while (ci < props.crystals && tries < props.crystals * 12) {
922:         tries++
923:         const x = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.75
924:         const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.75
925:         if (this.isReserved(x, z, .8) || this.isWaterDeep(x, z)) continue
926:         const s = .5 + this.rand() * 1.5
927:         dummy.position.set(x, this.zone.heightAt(x, z) + s * .35, z)
928:         dummy.rotation.set((this.rand() - .5) * .4, this.rand() * TAU, (this.rand() - .5) * .4)
929:         dummy.scale.setScalar(s)
930:         dummy.updateMatrix()
931:         crystals.setMatrixAt(ci, dummy.matrix)
932:         ci++
933:       }

Combate
275:

Pulsa atacar varias veces para encadenar un combo de tres golpes. El tercer golpe hace más daño y empuja. Esquivar consume aguante y te hace invulnerable durante un instante. Bloquear reduce el daño; si bloqueas justo en el momento del impacto, ejecutas un paro que aturde al enemigo y rellena aguante. La barra verde se agota: sin aguante no puedes esquivar ni bloquear.

279:

Debilita a una criatura por debajo de un tercio de su vida y pulsa Capturar. La probabilidad depende de su vida restante, tu suerte y la rareza. Las criaturas capturadas luchan a tu lado: invoca una y usa su habilidad con F. La esencia de resonancia las fortalece.

283:

Sube de nivel con experiencia, reparte puntos de atributo y equipa armas, armaduras, cascos y amuletos. Cada atributo tiene un efecto medible: vitalidad, maná, aguante, daño, defensa, velocidad, poder mágico, crítico y captura. Las misiones principales avanzan la historia; las secundarias dan equipo único y lore.

## Objective
- Build “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL”, a real, playable, original action-fantasy RPG for Android/browser (horizontal, Spanish from Spain) with 3 regions, combat, exploration, creature collection, customizable protagonist, story, UI, audio and high production ambition; GOTY is an aspiration, never a claimed award.

## Requirements
- Must be a real playable game, not a demo/design document/mockup.
- Original universe, characters, creatures, story, music and art; no existing IP.
- Regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats (Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte) with measurable effects and equipment affecting appearance where viable.
- Mobile-first horizontal layout, usable touch controls, Android support; Spanish (Spain).
- Quality targets: gameplay, combat, story, characters, world, exploration, art, music/sound, animations, AI, UI, performance, accessibility, system depth, originality.
- Do not invent unsupported platform capabilities; explain limitations and provide best alternative.

## Decisions
- Build as a Vite + Three.js browser game with procedural 3D visuals, Web Audio music/SFX, Canvas UI/maps, localStorage saves.
- Use 3 separate zones loaded via portals rather than one continuous world.
- Stylized low-poly/toon 3D with procedural terrain, props, structures, characters and creatures to avoid external assets and licensing issues.
- Bundle fonts locally (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`) under `public/fonts`.
- Main systems: third-person camera, 3-hit melee combo, dodge i-frames, block/parry, stamina, two class skills, creature capture/summon/upgrade, equipment/attributes, quests/dialogues/choices, waypoints/fast travel, shop, accessibility, auto-save.
- Eight creatures: Lumifín, Bramiel, Grímpola, Brasal, Umbrino, Cineronte, Petreluz, Celemn.
- Three classes/juramentos: Guardián, Filo, Vidente.
- Main quest chain of 13 quests plus 5 side quests.
- Endings: open or close the Velo, with epilogue influenced by choices/resonance.
- UI orchestration split into multiple classes to avoid oversized single file.
- Settings/audio/menu from title use overlays; gameplay pause menu is a separate screen.
- Player/enemy/creature models built procedurally in `src/world/models.js`; visual equipment changes via mesh rebuild.
- Combat model: player melee arcs, enemy windup telegraphs, ranged projectiles, boss phases and telegraphed specials, creature ability mapping per creature id.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repo; it was essentially empty except agent scaffolding, `README.md`, `start.sh`, `capture.sh`.
- Created project scaffold: `package.json` (Three.js ^0.187.0, Vite ^8.3.5), `index.html`, favicon, local fonts.
- Downloaded and bundled `cinzel.woff2`, `cormorant.woff2`, `cormorant-italic.woff2` into `public/fonts`.
- Wrote full CSS design system and responsive/touch/UI styles in `src/style.css`.
- Implemented utilities: `src/utils/math.js`, `src/utils/noise.js`.
- Implemented data: items/equipment/classes/difficulties, creatures, enemies/spawns, quests, zones/terrain/layouts, dialogues including story scenes and endings.
- Implemented systems: `AudioEngine` (procedural adaptive music + SFX), `Save`, `Input` (keyboard/mouse/touch/gamepad), `QuestManager`, `stats.js`.
- Implemented UI core: boot, HUD, joystick/buttons, dialogue typewriter, minimap/full map, toasts, banners, target/boss bars, cinematic subtitles, damage numbers.
- Implemented `TitleScreen`, `CreationScreen`, `MenuScreen` core tabs (personaje/equipo/inventario), `MenuExtra` (criaturas/misiones/mapa/ajustes/sistema/shop/help/credits).
- Wrote procedural SVG portraits in `src/ui/portraits.js`.
- Created `src/ui/EndScreens.js` with death, ending and credits screens.
- Created `src/core/Dialogue.js` interpreting NPC/scripted dialogue nodes, choices, actions, function transitions and close callbacks.
- Created `src/world/models.js` with procedural humanoid, enemy, creature, sword, name-tag and glow model factories.
- Created `src/fx/Effects.js` with particle bursts, ground rings, slashes, beams, auras and projectiles.
- Created `src/entities/Player.js` with movement/camera-relative control, combo attacks, dodge i-frames, block/parry, class skills, creature abilities/passives, potions, capture targeting, status effects, death and procedural animations.
- Created `src/entities/Enemy.js` with idle/chase/return AI, windup attacks, ranged/fan projectiles, boss phases, specials, stuns, slows, burn, knockback, loot/death hooks and animation.
- Ran `npm install` successfully (Three.js + Vite installed).
- Created `src/entities/Creature.js`: wild creature wander/flee behavior, HP/damage, capture state, respawn, name tags, motes, death/removal.
- Created `src/entities/NPC.js`: procedural NPC model, role styling, name tag, idle animation, player-facing behavior.
- Created `src/world/World.js`: sky shader, lights, fog, terrain vertex colors, water/lava/cloud planes, instanced trees/rocks/grass/flowers/crystals, zone-specific villages/ruins/camps/fortress/sanctuary/beacon/library/city/temple/altar, waypoints, portals, interactables, NPC/creature/enemy spawning, boss spawn, collision resolution, focus prompts, discovery, respawns, ambient animation and disposal.
- Audited all existing modules and their interfaces in detail; no successful build has been run yet.

### Active
- Need to create `src/core/Game.js` implementing all UI/quest/dialogue hooks and end-to-end flow.
- Need to create `src/main.js` bootstrapping `Game` and UI/audio.

- Need to verify save/load, quest progression, boss flow, creature capture, endings end-to-end.
- Need to fix known pending UI/data issues below.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Create `src/core/Game.js`: renderer/camera/loop, title/creation stages, save/load, zone loading/transitions, quest hooks, dialogue flow, interactions, combat orchestration, bosses, shop, settings, endings, retry/death, auto-save.

4. Add UI missing helpers: `refreshHUD()` and `captureFlash()`.
5. Fix `UI.openSettings(from)` to pass `from === 'title'` into `MenuScreen.open`; reset stale `menuScreen.el`/shop state on `UI.showTitle`.
6. Fix `TitleScreen` “Nueva partida” to include “Start Game” in aria-label for `capture.sh` auto-start.
7. Fix `MenuExtra` help/credits close handlers from title (currently calls `ui.showTitle`, duplicating title); add missing `difficulty` action handler in `MenuScreen`; allow settings render with no save.
8. Add `despertar.next = 'sombras_ribera'` so declining “prepare” does not dead-end the main quest.
9. Add `effectiveStats(stats, className)`/class-bonus application; patch `Player` and `MenuScreen` derive calls.

12. Implement boss orchestration: auto-trigger Coloso/Varok/Custodio, Varok/Custodio post-dialogues before quest completion, altar-triggered Convergence, ending dialogue and final screens.
13. Run `npm run build`, fix errors, then `npm run dev`/`npm run preview` on 3002 and Playwright verify screenshots and interactions.

15. Replace `README.md` with real game documentation, setup, controls, features, Android/browser limitations, honest GOTY framing; add font OFL license files.

282:   buildTerrain() {
283:     const zone = this.zone
284:     const size = zone.bounds * 2
285:     const seg = this.quality === 'alta' ? 160 : this.quality === 'media' ? 120 : this.quality === 'baja' ? 78 : 136
286:     const geo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(size, size, seg, seg)
287:     geo.rotateX(-Math.PI / 2)
288:     const pos = geo.attributes.position
289:     const colors = []
290:     const cGround = new THREE.Color(zone.palette.ground)
291:     const cGround2 = new THREE.Color(zone.palette.ground2)
292:     const cRock = new THREE.Color(zone.palette.rock)
293:     const cWater = new THREE.Color(zone.palette.water)
294:     const tmp = new THREE.Color()
295:     for (let i = 0; i < pos.count; i++) {
296:       const x = pos.getX(i), z = pos.getZ(i)
297:       const h = zone.heightAt(x, z)
298:       pos.setY(i, h)
299:       const alt = clamp((h + 2) / 14, 0, 1)
300:       tmp.copy(cGround).lerp(cGround2, alt)
301:       if (h > 5.5) tmp.lerp(cRock, clamp((h - 5.5) / 8, 0, .7))
302:       if (zone.isWater?.(x, z) && h < -1.1) tmp.lerp(cWater, .65)
303:       const variation = .88 + (Math.sin(x * 1.7 + z * 2.3) * .5 + .5) * .2
304:       tmp.multiplyScalar(variation)
305:       colors.push(tmp.r, tmp.g, tmp.b)
306:     }
307:     geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors, 3))
308:     geo.computeVertexNormals()
309:     const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
310:       vertexColors: true, roughness: 1, metalness: 0, flatShading: true
311:     })
312:     const terrain = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat)
313:     terrain.receiveShadow = true
314:     this.group.add(terrain)
315:     this.terrain = terrain
316:   }

792:     const leafMat = style === 'dead'

799:     const trunks = new THREE.InstancedMesh(trunkGeo, trunkMat, treeCount)
800:     const leaves = new THREE.InstancedMesh(leafGeo, leafMat, treeCount)
801:     trunks.castShadow = leaves.castShadow = this.quality !== 'baja'

809:       const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.84

1038:     const wood = std(0x5c4430)

1040:     const stone = std(0x777263)
1041:     if (def.type === 'chest') {

1053:     } else if (def.type === 'ore') {

1058:         const shard = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(.18 + Math.random() * .1, 0), std(0xa9c6e2, { emissive: 0x7faad4, emissiveIntensity: .28, metalness: .45 }))
1059:         shard.position.set((Math.random() - .5) * .8, .45 + Math.random() * .4, (Math.random() - .5) * .8)
1060:         shard.rotation.set(Math.random(), Math.random(), Math.random())

1063:     } else if (def.type === 'herb') {
1064:       for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
1065:         const a = i / 5 * TAU

250:   clampPosition() {
251:     const world = this.game.world
252:     if (!world) return
253:     const zone = world.zone
254:     const b = zone.bounds - 4
255:     this.pos.x = clamp(this.pos.x, -b, b)
256:     this.pos.z = clamp(this.pos.z, -b, b)
257:     if (zone.isWater?.(this.pos.x, this.pos.z)) {
258:       const h = zone.heightAt(this.pos.x, this.pos.z)
259:       if (h < (zone.id === 'drakmor' ? -1.8 : -2.5)) {
260:         this.pos.x -= this.velocity.x * .01
261:         this.pos.z -= this.velocity.z * .01

264:     const c = world.resolveCollision?.(this.pos.x, this.pos.z, .55)
265:     if (c) { this.pos.x = c.x; this.pos.z = c.z }
266:     if (world.bossArenaLock) {
267:       const a = world.bossArenaLock
268:       const d = Math.hypot(this.pos.x - a.x, this.pos.z - a.z)
269:       if (d > a.radius) {
270:         const k = a.radius / d
271:         this.pos.x = a.x + (this.pos.x - a.x) * k
272:         this.pos.z = a.z + (this.pos.z - a.z) * k

407:   performHit() {
408:     const game = this.game
409:     const reach = this.comboIndex === 2 ? 3.1 : 2.45
410:     const arc = this.comboIndex === 2 ? Math.PI * .9 : Math.PI * .62
411:     const dmgBase = this.derived.attack * (this.comboIndex === 2 ? 1.85 : this.comboIndex === 1 ? 1.12 : 1)
412:     const origin = new THREE.Vector3(this.pos.x, this.pos.y + 1, this.pos.z)
413:     const dir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(this.facing), 0, Math.cos(this.facing))
414:     game.fx.slash(this.pos, this.facing, this.comboIndex === 2 ? 0xffc46a : 0xffe6c0, this.comboIndex === 2 ? 2 : 1.45)
415:     let hits = 0
416:     for (const enemy of game.world?.enemies || []) {
417:       if (!enemy.alive) continue
418:       const to = new THREE.Vector3(enemy.pos.x - this.pos.x, 0, enemy.pos.z - this.pos.z)
419:       const d = to.length()
420:       if (d > reach + enemy.def.radius) continue
421:       to.normalize()
422:       const dot = dir.dot(to)
423:       if (dot < Math.cos(arc / 2)) continue
424:       const crit = Math.random() < this.derived.crit
425:       let dmg = dmgBase * (crit ? this.derived.critMult : 1) * (0.93 + Math.random() * .14)
426:       if (enemy.def.boss) dmg *= .92
427:       enemy.takeDamage(Math.round(dmg), { crit, source: 'player', dir: to.clone(), combo: this.comboIndex })
428:       hits++
429:     }
430:     if (hits) {
431:       this.outOfCombat = 0
432:       game.hitStop = Math.max(game.hitStop, this.comboIndex === 2 ? .11 : .055)
433:       game.shakeCamera?.(this.comboIndex === 2 ? .24 : .12, .18)
434:       game.audio?.sfx('hit')

Combate
275:

Pulsa atacar varias veces para encadenar un combo de tres golpes. El tercer golpe hace más daño y empuja. Esquivar consume aguante y te hace invulnerable durante un instante. Bloquear reduce el daño; si bloqueas justo en el momento del impacto, ejecutas un paro que aturde al enemigo y rellena aguante. La barra verde se agota: sin aguante no puedes esquivar ni bloquear.

Resonancia y criaturas
279:

Debilita a una criatura por debajo de un tercio de su vida y pulsa Capturar. La probabilidad depende de su vida restante, tu suerte y la rareza. Las criaturas capturadas luchan a tu lado: invoca una y usa su habilidad con F. La esencia de resonancia las fortalece.

Progresión
283:

Sube de nivel con experiencia, reparte puntos de atributo y equipa armas, armaduras, cascos y amuletos. Cada atributo tiene un efecto medible: vitalidad, maná, aguante, daño, defensa, velocidad, poder mágico, crítico y captura. Las misiones principales avanzan la historia; las secundarias dan equipo único y lore.

287:

Descubre santuarios acercándote a ellos. Desde el mapa puedes viajar entre santuarios descubiertos de la región actual, siempre fuera de combate. Los portales conectan Valdoria, Drakmor y Kansordore cuando la historia lo permite.

## Objective
- Build “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL”, a real, playable, original action-fantasy RPG for Android/browser (horizontal, Spanish from Spain) with 3 regions, combat, exploration, creature collection, customizable protagonist, story, UI, audio and high production ambition; GOTY is an aspiration, never a claimed award.

## Requirements
- Must be a real playable game, not a demo/design document/mockup.
- Original universe, characters, creatures, story, music and art; no existing IP.
- Regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats (Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte) with measurable effects and equipment affecting appearance where viable.
- Mobile-first horizontal layout, usable touch controls, Android support; Spanish (Spain).
- Quality targets: gameplay, combat, story, characters, world, exploration, art, music/sound, animations, AI, UI, performance, accessibility, system depth, originality.
- Do not invent unsupported platform capabilities; explain limitations and provide best alternative.

- Build as a Vite + Three.js browser game with procedural 3D visuals, Web Audio music/SFX, Canvas UI/maps, localStorage saves.
- Use 3 separate zones loaded via portals rather than one continuous world.
- Stylized low-poly/toon 3D with procedural terrain, props, structures, characters and creatures to avoid external assets and licensing issues.
- Bundle fonts locally (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`) under `public/fonts`.
- Main systems: third-person camera, 3-hit melee combo, dodge i-frames, block/parry, stamina, two class skills, creature capture/summon/upgrade, equipment/attributes, quests/dialogues/choices, waypoints/fast travel, shop, accessibility, auto-save.
- Eight creatures: Lumifín, Bramiel, Grímpola, Brasal, Umbrino, Cineronte, Petreluz, Celemn.
- Three classes/juramentos: Guardián, Filo, Vidente.
- Main quest chain of 13 quests plus 5 side quests.
- Endings: open or close the Velo, with epilogue influenced by choices/resonance.
- UI orchestration split into multiple classes to avoid oversized single file.
- Settings/audio/menu from title use overlays; gameplay pause menu is a separate screen.
- Player/enemy/creature models built procedurally in `src/world/models.js`; visual equipment changes via mesh rebuild.
- Combat model: player melee arcs, enemy windup telegraphs, ranged projectiles, boss phases and telegraphed specials, creature ability mapping per creature id.

Combate
275:

Pulsa atacar varias veces para encadenar un combo de tres golpes. El tercer golpe hace más daño y empuja. Esquivar consume aguante y te hace invulnerable durante un instante. Bloquear reduce el daño; si bloqueas justo en el momento del impacto, ejecutas un paro que aturde al enemigo y rellena aguante. La barra verde se agota: sin aguante no puedes esquivar ni bloquear.

Resonancia y criaturas
279:

Debilita a una criatura por debajo de un tercio de su vida y pulsa Capturar. La probabilidad depende de su vida restante, tu suerte y la rareza. Las criaturas capturadas luchan a tu lado: invoca una y usa su habilidad con F. La esencia de resonancia las fortalece.

Progresión
283:

Sube de nivel con experiencia, reparte puntos de atributo y equipa armas, armaduras, cascos y amuletos. Cada atributo tiene un efecto medible: vitalidad, maná, aguante, daño, defensa, velocidad, poder mágico, crítico y captura. Las misiones principales avanzan la historia; las secundarias dan equipo único y lore.
