160:     let mx = right.x * axis.x + forward.x * (-axis.y)
161:     let mz = right.z * axis.x + forward.z * (-axis.y)
162:     const mlen = Math.hypot(mx, mz)
163:     if (mlen > .01) { mx /= mlen; mz /= mlen }
164:     const moving = mlen > .05
165: 
166:     let speed = this.derived.speed
167:     if (this.blocking) speed *= .44
168:     if (this.attackTimer > 0) speed *= .16
169:     if (this.dodgeTime > 0) speed = 0
170: 
171:     if (this.dodgeTime > 0) {
172:       this.pos.x += this.dodgeDir.x * 13.5 * dt
173:       this.pos.z += this.dodgeDir.z * 13.5 * dt
174:       this.facing = Math.atan2(this.dodgeDir.x, this.dodgeDir.z)
175:     } else if (moving) {
176:       this.pos.x += mx * speed * dt
177:       this.pos.z += mz * speed * dt
178:       this.facing = dampAngle(this.facing, Math.atan2(mx, mz), 14, dt)
179:       this.moveSpeed = speed
180:     } else {
181:       this.moveSpeed = 0
182:       if (this.attackTimer > 0) this.facing = dampAngle(this.facing, yaw + Math.PI, 16, dt)
183:     }
184: 
185:     this.clampPosition()
186:     const zone = game.world?.zone
187:     const ground = zone ? zone.heightAt(this.pos.x, this.pos.z) : 0
188:     this.pos.y = ground + .03
189:     this.mesh.position.copy(this.pos)
190:     this.mesh.rotation.y = this.facing
191: 
192:     // Animación de ataque
193:     if (this.attackTimer > 0) {
194:       this.attackTimer -= dt
195:       const spent = (this.comboIndex === 2 ? .46 : .34) - this.attackTimer
196:       if (!this.attackDidHit && spent >= this.attackHitAt) {
197:         this.attackDidHit = true
198:         this.performHit()
199:       }
200:       if (this.attackTimer <= 0) {
201:         this.attackTimer = 0
202:         if (this.comboQueued && this.comboIndex < 2) this.startAttack(true)
203:         else this.attackCD = .08
204:       }
205:     } else if (this.comboTimer > 0) {
206:       this.comboTimer -= dt
207:       if (this.comboTimer <= 0) this.comboIndex = 0
208:     }
209: 
210:     if (this.blocking && this.parryReady > 0) this.parryReady -= dt
211:     if (this.iFrames > 0) this.iFrames -= dt
212:     if (this.dodgeTime > 0) {
213:       this.dodgeTime -= dt
214:       if (this.dodgeTime <= 0) this.dodgeTime = 0
215:     }
216: 
217:     // Regeneración
218:     this.outOfCombat += dt
219:     if (this.outOfCombat > 4.5) {
220:       this.hp = Math.min(this.derived.hp, this.hp + this.derived.hpRegen * dt)
221:       const regen = this.passiveMods().regen + (this.save.activeCreature === 'lumifin' ? 2 : 0)
222:       if (regen) this.hp = Math.min(this.derived.hp, this.hp + regen * dt)
223:     }
224:     this.mp = Math.min(this.derived.mp, this.mp + this.derived.manaRegen * dt)
225:     this.stamina = Math.min(this.derived.stamina, this.stamina + this.derived.staminaRegen * (this.blocking ? .18 : 1) * dt)
226: 
227:     this.updateCompanion(dt)
228:     this.updateAura()
229:     this.updateCaptureTarget()
230:     this.updateBrasalAura(dt)
231:     this.animate(dt)
232:   }

250:   clampPosition() {
251:     const world = this.game.world
252:     if (!world) return
253:     const zone = world.zone
254:     const b = zone.bounds - 4
255:     this.pos.x = clamp(this.pos.x, -b, b)
256:     this.pos.z = clamp(this.pos.z, -b, b)
257:     if (zone.isWater?.(this.pos.x, this.pos.z)) {
258:       const h = zone.heightAt(this.pos.x, this.pos.z)
259:       if (h < (zone.id === 'drakmor' ? -1.8 : -2.5)) {
260:         this.pos.x -= this.velocity.x * .01
261:         this.pos.z -= this.velocity.z * .01
262:       }
263:     }
264:     const c = world.resolveCollision?.(this.pos.x, this.pos.z, .55)
265:     if (c) { this.pos.x = c.x; this.pos.z = c.z }
266:     if (world.bossArenaLock) {
267:       const a = world.bossArenaLock
268:       const d = Math.hypot(this.pos.x - a.x, this.pos.z - a.z)
269:       if (d > a.radius) {
270:         const k = a.radius / d
271:         this.pos.x = a.x + (this.pos.x - a.x) * k
272:         this.pos.z = a.z + (this.pos.z - a.z) * k
273:       }
274:     }
275:   }

277:   updateCaptureTarget() {

282:       if (c.caught || c.dead) continue
283:       const d = Math.hypot(c.pos.x - this.pos.x, c.pos.z - this.pos.z)
284:       if (d < bestD && c.hp / c.maxHp <= .45) { best = c; bestD = d }
285:     }
286:     this.captureTarget = best

289:   updateCompanion(dt) {
290:     if (!this.companion) return
291:     const t = performance.now() * .001
292:     const side = Math.sin(t * .7 + this.companion.userData.phase) * .45
293:     const targetX = this.pos.x + Math.cos(this.facing) * this.companionOffset.z + Math.sin(this.facing) * (1.2 + side)
294:     const targetZ = this.pos.z - Math.sin(this.facing) * this.companionOffset.z + Math.cos(this.facing) * (1.2 + side)
295:     const ground = this.game.world?.zone?.heightAt(targetX, targetZ) ?? 0
296:     const targetY = ground + 1.15 + Math.sin(t * 2.2 + (this.companion.userData.phase || 0)) * .12
297:     this.companion.position.x += (targetX - this.companion.position.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.4)
298:     this.companion.position.z += (targetZ - this.companion.position.z) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.4)
299:     this.companion.position.y += (targetY - this.companion.position.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 4.2)
300:     this.companion.rotation.y = dampAngle(this.companion.rotation.y, this.facing, 6, dt)
301:     const rig = this.companion.userData.rig
302:     if (rig?.wings) rig.wings.forEach((w, i) => { w.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 8 + i * Math.PI) * .35 })
303:     if (rig?.body) rig.body.position.y = Math.sin(t * 2.4) * .04
304:   }

326:   animate(dt, frozen = false) {
327:     const rig = this.mesh.userData.rig
328:     if (!rig) return
329:     const t = performance.now() * .001
330:     let speed = frozen ? 0 : this.moveSpeed
331:     if (this.dodgeTime > 0) speed = 12
332:     this.walkPhase += dt * (2.4 + speed * .72)
333:     const swing = Math.sin(this.walkPhase) * Math.min(.75, speed * .07)
334:     const bob = Math.abs(Math.sin(this.walkPhase * 2)) * Math.min(.06, speed * .006)
335:     rig.body.position.y = bob + (this.dead ? -.35 : 0)
336:     rig.legL.rotation.x = swing
337:     rig.legR.rotation.x = -swing
338:     rig.armL.rotation.x = -swing * .7
339:     rig.armR.rotation.x = swing * .35
340:     rig.armL.rotation.z = -.08
341:     rig.armR.rotation.z = .08
342:     rig.body.rotation.z = this.dodgeTime > 0 ? .25 : 0
343:     rig.head.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * .7) * .04
344:     rig.head.rotation.x = this.blocking ? .12 : 0
345: 
346:     if (this.attackTimer > 0) {
347:       const total = this.comboIndex === 2 ? .46 : .34
348:       const p = 1 - this.attackTimer / total
349:       const ang = this.comboIndex === 2
350:         ? -2.3 + p * 3.6
351:         : (this.comboIndex === 1 ? 1.8 - p * 3.4 : -1.4 + p * 2.9)
352:       rig.armR.rotation.x = ang
353:       rig.armR.rotation.z = -.45 + Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * .9
354:       rig.body.rotation.y = Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * (this.comboIndex === 2 ? .55 : .32)
355:     } else {
356:       rig.body.rotation.y = 0
357:     }
358:     if (this.blocking) {
359:       rig.armL.rotation.x = -1.2
360:       rig.armL.rotation.z = .8
361:       rig.armR.rotation.x = -.45
362:     }
363:     if (this.hurtFlash > 0) {
364:       this.hurtFlash -= dt
365:       this.mesh.traverse(o => { if (o.material?.emissive) o.material.emissive.setHex(0x6a1a14) })
366:     } else if (this.mesh.userData.lastFlash) {
367:       this.mesh.userData.lastFlash = false
368:       this.rebuildMaterialsEmission()
369:     }
370:   }

376:       }
377:     })

381:   startAttack(queued = false) {
382:     if (this.dead || this.attackCD > 0 || this.attackTimer > 0) return
383:     if (this.stamina < 5) { this.game.toast('Sin aguante para atacar.', '⚠'); return }
384:     if (!queued) {
385:       if (this.comboTimer > 0) this.comboIndex = (this.comboIndex + 1) % 3
386:       else this.comboIndex = 0
387:     } else this.comboIndex++
388:     this.stamina -= 5
389:     this.attackTimer = this.comboIndex === 2 ? .46 : .34
390:     this.attackHitAt = this.comboIndex === 2 ? .22 : .13
391:     this.attackDidHit = false
392:     this.comboQueued = false
393:     this.comboTimer = .9
394:     this.outOfCombat = 0

396:     this.game.shakeCamera?.(this.comboIndex === 2 ? .08 : .035, .12)

399:   queueCombo() {

404:     return false

407:   performHit() {
408:     const game = this.game
409:     const reach = this.comboIndex === 2 ? 3.1 : 2.45
410:     const arc = this.comboIndex === 2 ? Math.PI * .9 : Math.PI * .62
411:     const dmgBase = this.derived.attack * (this.comboIndex === 2 ? 1.85 : this.comboIndex === 1 ? 1.12 : 1)
412:     const origin = new THREE.Vector3(this.pos.x, this.pos.y + 1, this.pos.z)
413:     const dir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(this.facing), 0, Math.cos(this.facing))
414:     game.fx.slash(this.pos, this.facing, this.comboIndex === 2 ? 0xffc46a : 0xffe6c0, this.comboIndex === 2 ? 2 : 1.45)
415:     let hits = 0
416:     for (const enemy of game.world?.enemies || []) {
417:       if (!enemy.alive) continue
418:       const to = new THREE.Vector3(enemy.pos.x - this.pos.x, 0, enemy.pos.z - this.pos.z)
419:       const d = to.length()
420:       if (d > reach + enemy.def.radius) continue
421:       to.normalize()
422:       const dot = dir.dot(to)
423:       if (dot < Math.cos(arc / 2)) continue
424:       const crit = Math.random() < this.derived.crit
425:       let dmg = dmgBase * (crit ? this.derived.critMult : 1) * (0.93 + Math.random() * .14)
426:       if (enemy.def.boss) dmg *= .92
427:       enemy.takeDamage(Math.round(dmg), { crit, source: 'player', dir: to.clone(), combo: this.comboIndex })
428:       hits++
429:     }
430:     if (hits) {
431:       this.outOfCombat = 0
432:       game.hitStop = Math.max(game.hitStop, this.comboIndex === 2 ? .11 : .055)
433:       game.shakeCamera?.(this.comboIndex === 2 ? .24 : .12, .18)
434:       game.audio?.sfx('hit')
435:       if (this.comboIndex === 2) game.fx.ring(new THREE.Vector3(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, this.pos.z), 0xffd28a, 2.8, { life: .45 })
436:     }
437:   }

439:   dodge() {
440:     if (this.dead || this.dodgeTime > 0 || this.stamina < this.derived.dodgeCost) return
441:     const axis = this.game.input.axis()
442:     let dx = 0, dz = 0
443:     if (Math.abs(axis.x) + Math.abs(axis.y) > .1) {
444:       const yaw = this.game.cameraYaw
445:       const forward = { x: -Math.sin(yaw), z: -Math.cos(yaw) }
446:       const right = { x: Math.cos(yaw), z: -Math.sin(yaw) }
447:       dx = right.x * axis.x + forward.x * (-axis.y)
448:       dz = right.z * axis.x + forward.z * (-axis.y)
449:     } else {
450:       dx = Math.sin(this.facing); dz = Math.cos(this.facing)
451:     }
452:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1
453:     this.dodgeDir.set(dx / len, 0, dz / len)
454:     this.stamina -= this.derived.dodgeCost
455:     this.dodgeTime = .28
456:     this.iFrames = .34
457:     this.outOfCombat = 0
458:     this.game.audio?.sfx('dodge')
459:     this.game.fx.burst(new THREE.Vector3(this.pos.x, this.pos.y + .5, this.pos.z), 0xd8e8ff, 12, { speed: 1.5, life: .4 })

575:         let last = pos.clone()

content.text:
Portrait for 'sword' falls back player. Fine.

Now create stages.js. Need use `buildSky`, `buildLights` from World and `createHumanoid`, `createSword`, `makeGlow`. Ensure stage dispose disposes scene, textures. Could create materials.

Title stage:
- scene, camera.
- sky = buildSky(scene, ZONES.valdoria.palette)
- lights = buildLights(scene, palette, quality high maybe true)
- ground: CircleGeometry radius 55, maybe vertex-displace via PlaneGeometry 80x80 segments 48. Similar colors.
- central dais at 0,0? terain has height 0 center maybe. Use simple flat.
- skyline cones around.
- arch stones.
- sword in center scaled 5 at y=1.2, glow point light.
- motes.
- camera orbit.
- stage.update(dt): orbit yaw, camera position (sin yaw * 11, 5.2, cos yaw *11), lookAt (0,2,0), rotate sword group? glow pulse, motes. Keep camera maybe reveals composition; Title UI covers left, so place focal right-ish? Camera looking at center; UI left, our sword center visible in right half? It may be centered. Fine.

- stage.dispose: traverse geometry/material dispose, remove sky/sun. Textures dispose.

Creation stage:
- scene, camera fixed.
- background fog, dark, ground circle, rim.
- humanoid group at y=0 maybe ground platform at y=0. body scale 1.35, so head ~2.4.
- camera (0,1.8,5.4) lookAt (0,1.3,0)
- lights: hemi dim, key spotlight/directional, two rim point lights.
- circular dais, ring.
- preview mesh from createHumanoid. Auto rotate group.rotation.y += dt*0.35 unless manually rotated? We'll always rotate slowly, and rotate manually adds. Set user appears spinning which is nice; UI says drag.
- setPreview: dispose old, createHumanoid({appearance, equipment: STARTING_EQUIPMENT, scale:1.4}), add to pivot. Need remove and dispose old.
- stage.update pulses rings and slow spin.

Now Game.js services.

Let's determine quest flow edge cases:
- `despertar` starts on new game. First talk Iria triggers notifyTalk -> complete; next sombras_ribera after 1400ms. Good.
- In `iriaAccept`, choices start sombras_ribera early but `despertar` still active; when dialogue closes notifyTalk iria -> completes despertar, then auto next sombras won't start because state exists. Fine.
- "Primero necesito prepararme" closes without starting; despertar completes and next starts after 1400 to sombras. Add `next: 'sombras_ribera'` patch. Good.
- kill quest target 'corrompido' count 5: world has 6. Fine.
- don_resonancia: talk nara step0 -> advance to capture; notify capture; return talk.
- ruinas_vael: goto at radius 14; then braziers; when 3 interacted -> boss step. Boss trigger: third brazier `interactable` triggers notifyInteract and startBossFight('coloso_raiz') if quest active and step now boss. But if quest not active at that moment? fine. After boss death notifyKill advances completes. jar flag + rewards. Need portal unlocked `jar_obtained`.
- puerta_ceniza auto starts from next. goto portal target; World.notifyGoto checks step.pos [64,-50], radius 7. Interacting portal transitions to drakmor. Quest completion happens by goto before portal. Then tierras_ceniza starts after 1400.
- tierras_ceniza goto camp [2,58] radius 12 -> then talk Kaelen. If player enters drakmor start at [0,66] which is within 12 of [2,58]? distance sqrt(4+64)=8.2 yes. Goto auto advances quickly. Then talk Kaelen step1 -> complete; next hija_ceniza.
- Kaelen dialogue for just tierras_ceniza doesn't auto start, but QuestManager completes and next starts.
- hija_ceniza interact memoria_ceniza 3; objects IDs. notifyInteract passes target `memoria_ceniza`; good. Talk Kaelen complete -> next senor_ceniza.
- senor_ceniza: interact fortress_gate; when opened, quest advances to boss. Then start varok_intro dialogue rather than spawn immediately? Better when gate opened: start dialogue varok_intro; choice calls game.startBossFight('varok'). The player needs walk to arena? Gate is at z=-36, boss arena z=-58. If spawn immediately at arena, player can walk. But dialogue intro starts at gate. Good. On open gate: set flag gate_open, remove collider/open visual, notifyInteract, then after 500ms startScripted('varok_intro'). Boss only spawns when choice. Fine. But if player already opened gate and re-approaches, focus skip. If quest step boss and varok not spawned, maybe spawn on entering arena. We'll add check in updateBossTriggers: if quest senor_ceniza step boss and !varok_spawned and player within 12 of arena -> startBossFight('varok') (without intro if not had). For robustness.
- varok defeat: dialogue varok_after -> choice spare/consume; on close notifyKill('varok') completes quest, rewards lagrima, flag varok_defeated. Next puerta_cielo auto. Portal unlock. In spareVarok/consumeVarok set flags varok_spared / varok_consumed. Note SCRIPTED choice act applies before node shown; varok_after choices each have act as third param C(label, to, act) => spare. Good.
- `varok_after` starts immediately on death but `notifyKill` not called until dialogue close. However enemy removal occurs after 2.2s; fine.
- On dialogue close, if pending boss quest, notifyKill -> rewards and next quest start via 1400. Need ensure `onDialogueClosed` sets state playing before notify? state playing so next dialogue? fine.
- puerta_cielo goto portal -> transition.
- ciudad_cielo goto biblioteca radius 12 at [-48,6], then talk seraphine. Start at [0,76] so must travel. Good.
- tres_sellos interact 3 -> talk seraphine.
- jugador_cero goto templo radius 14 then boss custiodio. Goto advances to boss. Then auto trigger custodio fight when near arena. Or maybe start via trigger. We'll auto trigger with intro when near [0,-58] radius 16 and quest step boss. Same for coloso? For coloso start when braziers lit. For convergence altar.
- custodio defeat -> dialogue custodio_after -> on close notifyKill completes jugador_cero, rewards corazon_cero? Wait rewards for jugador_cero: corazon_cero. next convergencia auto starts. Then altar interaction starts convergence_intro -> boss. Note altar quest step 0 interact; notifyInteract advances to boss. Then start dialogue convergence_intro. Choice summon boss.
- convergencia defeat -> notifyKill completes quest adds espada_celestial, then after 1.4s startScripted('ending'). But also next null. queueEnding called by choice. onDialogueClosed -> finishEnding. Need state playing while dialogue. `finishEnding` shows ending screen; state 'ending'; audio? etc. Need set flags.ending. resumeAfterEnding returns to playing after closing end screen. But after ending, quest complete, player can explore; flags.ending set, boss dead. Fine. `resumeAfterEnding` hides UI? EndScreens already removed. set state playing, maybe region card. Save.
- boss arena unlock: startBossFight sets world.bossArenaLock = {x,z,radius}. On death clear. But if player dies during boss, retry should respawn and respawn boss full. On player death set state dead, hide boss, unlock arena, maybe reset boss? Boss still alive at low HP, retry could cheat. Better retryFromCheckpoint: reload zone from checkpoint, which rebuilds world and boss will respawn only via trigger. For gate opened flag persists so re-trigger. For varok: flag gate_open; retry loads zone at checkpoint? checkpoint set at zone entry or waypoint. Hmm. We can set checkpoint on loadZone and on waypoint interact/discovery. On death, retryFromCheckpoint reloads current zone at checkpoint pos and resets boss quest step? Quest step boss remains. Trigger will re-spawn boss when near arena. For varok, gate_open flag persists; near arena triggers. Good. For coloso, braziers flags persist, boss step persists; trigger near arena spawns. For custodio, step boss persists; trigger near arena. For convergence, step boss persists; trigger near altar spawns. Need `updateBossTriggers` checks active quest step type boss and target id. Good.

- checkpoint: `setCheckpoint(x,z)` store {zone,x,z}; on zone load set to start or provided. Waypoint interaction set checkpoint. On save include checkpoint.
- retryFromCheckpoint: if none use zone start. Reload zone with saved state maybe health full. Player newly constructed full.

- death: player.die calls onPlayerDeath: state dead after 800ms; hide HUD? Show death screen after 900ms; audio; UI hideBoss. Since player.update returns if dead. Use setTimeout.

- `onQuestStep`: toast for objective changes? QuestManager calls on start. Add toast only maybe not to overwhelm. Could play quest sfx. We'll just update UI and if step boss show banner "Objetivo: ...". `onQuestComplete`: if main quest, maybe region card? no; toast already. For completions needed flags? handled by QuestManager. Additional side quest unique flags? e.g. Tovin completing espada_rota gives sword equipment, reward adds item. Not auto-equip. Fine. Mera reward.
- `nara_bond` flag set in dialogue. good.
- `truth_revealed` flag maybe when tres_sellos completed? Seraphine side quest condition includes done(tres_sellos) so okay.
- `used_faro_ceniza` set in markUsed via interactables id `faro_ceniza` -> flag `used_faro_ceniza`, beacon visual only at build time; markUsed lights flame. good.

Interactables:
```
interactWith(obj):
 switch:
 chest: add loot, markUsed, quests? no collect maybe; toast; sfx
 ore/herb: addItem, markUsed, quests.updateCollect()
 echo: dialogue with text, markUsed? Echo step target eco_pasado; notifyInteract('eco_pasado', id). For echo type target may be undefined; call notifyInteract(obj.def.target||obj.def.id, obj.def.id). Echoes should not be permanently used? Quest requires 3 distinct ecos; markUsed true. World focus includes echo even used (`if (o.used && o.type !== 'echo') continue`), so can repeat. Fine, notifyInteract ignores duplicates.
 memory/seal: add item? memory token item and progress; markUsed; notifyInteract(target)
 brazier: markUsed; notifyInteract('brazier_vael', id); if quest ruinas active and count 3 -> spawnBoss coloso after delay.
 gate: open; markUsed? type gate; set flags.gate_open; world openGateVisual; remove collider; notifyInteract('fortress_gate'); start varok intro.
 beacon: markUsed; notifyInteract('faro_ceniza'); flag used...
 altar: notifyInteract('altar_convergencia'); if quest convergencia active -> start convergence intro.
```
Chest interactions don't have target; could add quest collect if loot contains quest item? use quests.updateCollect.

- `notifyInteract` uses `objectId` unique. For braziers target 'brazier_vael' and ids distinct. Good.

Portal:
```
if locked: toast(hint) + sfx error
else transitionZone(target,targetPos)
```
transitionZone:
- state='transition'; UI fadeOut black; maybe save; loadZone(zone,pos) after 350ms; fadeIn; region card; autoSave. Need prevent double. Use async.
- preserve quest, flags, save zone. zone loaded; player placed; checkpoint updated.
- if target is drakmor from valdoria, after load quest puerta_ceniza may already complete from goto. Fine.
- ensure portal hint.

Zone load:
```
async loadZone(zoneId, pos, {fade=false}={})
```
We'll keep synchronous `enterZone` for simplicity with UI fade calls. `loadZone(zoneId, position, opts)`:
- cleanup current world/player/fx (not scene)
- scene if gameplay: `this.scene = this.scene || new THREE.Scene()`; but after title/creation we need new scene. We can always create new `THREE.Scene()` in loadZone, dispose old stage/world. Sequence.
- this.world = new World(this, zoneId)
- create player if save: new Player(this,save); player.place(x,z); scene.add(player.mesh); player.setCompanion(save.activeCreature); 
- ui.buildHUD()

## Objective
- Build “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL”, a real, playable, original action-fantasy RPG for Android/browser (horizontal, Spanish from Spain) with 3 regions, combat, exploration, creature collection, customizable protagonist, story, UI, audio and high production ambition; GOTY is an aspiration, never a claimed award.

## Requirements
- Must be a real playable game, not a demo/design document/mockup.
- Original universe, characters, creatures, story, music and art; no existing IP.
- Regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats (Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte) with measurable effects and equipment affecting appearance where viable.
- Mobile-first horizontal layout, usable touch controls, Android support; Spanish (Spain).
- Quality targets: gameplay, combat, story, characters, world, exploration, art, music/sound, animations, AI, UI, performance, accessibility, system depth, originality.
- Do not invent unsupported platform capabilities; explain limitations and provide best alternative.

## Decisions
- Build as a Vite + Three.js browser game with procedural 3D visuals, Web Audio music/SFX, Canvas UI/maps, localStorage saves.
- Use 3 separate zones loaded via portals rather than one continuous world.
- Stylized low-poly/toon 3D with procedural terrain, props, structures, characters and creatures to avoid external assets and licensing issues.
- Bundle fonts locally (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`) under `public/fonts`.
- Main systems: third-person camera, 3-hit melee combo, dodge i-frames, block/parry, stamina, two class skills, creature capture/summon/upgrade, equipment/attributes, quests/dialogues/choices, waypoints/fast travel, shop, accessibility, auto-save.
- Eight creatures: Lumifín, Bramiel, Grímpola, Brasal, Umbrino, Cineronte, Petreluz, Celemn.
- Three classes/juramentos: Guardián, Filo, Vidente.
- Main quest chain of 13 quests plus 5 side quests.
- Endings: open or close the Velo, with epilogue influenced by choices/resonance.
- UI orchestration split into multiple classes to avoid oversized single file.
- Settings/audio/menu from title use overlays; gameplay pause menu is a separate screen.
- Player/enemy/creature models built procedurally in `src/world/models.js`; visual equipment changes via mesh rebuild.
- Combat model: player melee arcs, enemy windup telegraphs, ranged projectiles, boss phases and telegraphed specials, creature ability mapping per creature id.
- Title backdrop will reuse procedural landscape/arch/sword staging; character creation gets a dedicated 3D preview stage.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repo; it was essentially empty except agent scaffolding, `README.md`, `start.sh`, `capture.sh`.
- Created project scaffold: `package.json` (Three.js ^0.187.0, Vite ^8.3.5), `index.html`, favicon, local fonts.
- Downloaded and bundled `cinzel.woff2`, `cormorant.woff2`, `cormorant-italic.woff2` into `public/fonts`.
- Wrote full CSS design system and responsive/touch/UI styles in `src/style.css`.
- Implemented utilities: `src/utils/math.js`, `src/utils/noise.js`.
- Implemented data: items/equipment/classes/difficulties, creatures, enemies/spawns, quests, zones/terrain/layouts, dialogues including story scenes and endings.
- Implemented systems: `AudioEngine` (procedural adaptive music + SFX), `Save`, `Input` (keyboard/mouse/touch/gamepad), `QuestManager`, `stats.js`.
- Implemented UI core: boot, HUD, joystick/buttons, dialogue typewriter, minimap/full map, toasts, banners, target/boss bars, cinematic subtitles, damage numbers.
- Implemented `TitleScreen`, `CreationScreen`, `MenuScreen` core tabs (personaje/equipo/inventario), `MenuExtra` (criaturas/misiones/mapa/ajustes/sistema/shop/help/credits).
- Wrote procedural SVG portraits in `src/ui/portraits.js`.
- Created `src/ui/EndScreens.js` with death, ending and credits screens.
- Created `src/core/Dialogue.js` interpreting NPC/scripted dialogue nodes, choices, actions, function transitions and close callbacks.
- Created `src/world/models.js` with procedural humanoid, enemy, creature, sword, name-tag and glow model factories.
- Created `src/fx/Effects.js` with particle bursts, ground rings, slashes, beams, auras and projectiles.
- Created `src/entities/Player.js` with movement/camera-relative control, combo attacks, dodge i-frames, block/parry, class skills, creature abilities/passives, potions, capture targeting, status effects, death and procedural animations.
- Created `src/entities/Enemy.js` with idle/chase/return AI, windup attacks, ranged/fan projectiles, boss phases, specials, stuns, slows, burn, knockback, loot/death hooks and animation.
- Created `src/entities/Creature.js`: wild creature wander/flee behavior, HP/damage, capture state, respawn, name tags, motes, death/removal.
- Created `src/entities/NPC.js`: procedural NPC model, role styling, name tag, idle animation, player-facing behavior.
- Created `src/world/World.js`: sky shader, lights, fog, terrain vertex colors, water/lava/cloud planes, instanced trees/rocks/grass/flowers/crystals, zone-specific villages/ruins/camps/fortress/sanctuary/beacon/library/city/temple/altar, waypoints, portals, interactables, NPC/creature/enemy spawning, boss spawn, collision resolution, focus prompts, discovery, respawns, ambient animation and disposal.
- Ran `npm install` successfully (Three.js + Vite installed).
- Audited all existing modules and interfaces in detail; no successful build has been run yet.

### Active
- Need to create `src/core/Game.js` implementing all UI/quest/dialogue hooks and end-to-end flow.
- Need to create `src/main.js` bootstrapping `Game` and UI/audio.
- Need to run build and fix syntax/module/reference errors across new modules.
- Need to start server on port 3002 and use Playwright to verify title, creation, HUD, combat, menus, dialogue, mobile layout.
- Need to verify save/load, quest progression, boss flow, creature capture, endings end-to-end.
- Need to fix known pending UI/data issues below.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Create `src/core/Game.js`: renderer/camera/loop, title/creation stages, save/load, zone loading/transitions, quest hooks, dialogue flow, interactions, combat orchestration, bosses, shop, settings, endings, retry/death, auto-save.
2. Create `src/main.js` bootstrapping `Game` and UI/audio; initialize audio on first gesture; await fonts; handle boot/errors.
3. Wire all missing methods referenced by UI/data: `game.openMenu`, `closeMenu`, `closeShop`, `beginCharacterCreation`, `setCreationPreview`, `rotateCreationPreview`, `startNewGame`, `continueGame`, `returnToTitle`, `saveSummary`, `quests`, `world`, `zones`, `player`, `save`, `inventoryCount`, `addItem`, `removeItem`, `useItem`, `equipItem`, `spendAttribute`, `summonCreature`, `upgradeCreature`, `buyItem`, `fastTravel`, `isWaypointDiscovered`, `openShop`, `startBossFight`, `spareVarok`, `consumeVarok`, `queueEnding`, `finishEnding`, `applySettings`, `autoSave`, `saveGame`, `loadGameFromMenu`, `resetSave`, `cameraYaw`, `cameraFocus`, `skipCinematic`, `projectPoint`, `shakeCamera`, `hitStop`, `difficulty`, `onQuestStep`, `onQuestComplete`, `onDialogueClosed`, `onEnemyDeath`, `onPlayerDeath`, `retryFromCheckpoint`, `resumeAfterEnding`, `tryCapture`, `usePotion`, `addXP`, `addGold`, `addResonance`, `toast`, `setDifficulty`, `setCheckpoint`, `qualityLevel`, `onBossAggro`, `onBossHit`.
4. Add UI missing helpers: `refreshHUD()` and `captureFlash()`.
5. Fix `UI.openSettings(from)` to pass `from === 'title'` into `MenuScreen.open`; reset stale `menuScreen.el`/shop state on `UI.showTitle`; call `titleScreen.hide()`/`creationScreen.hide()`.
6. Fix `TitleScreen` “Nueva partida” to include “Start Game” in aria-label for `capture.sh` auto-start.
7. Fix `MenuExtra` help/credits close handlers from title (currently calls `ui.showTitle`, duplicating title); add missing `difficulty` action handler in `MenuScreen`; allow settings render with no save.
8. Add `despertar.next = 'sombras_ribera'` so declining “prepare” does not dead-end the main quest.
9. Add `effectiveStats(stats, className)`/class-bonus application; patch `Player` and `MenuScreen` derive calls.
10. Patch `Player.performHit()` to also damage `world.creatureSpawns` so capture is achievable.
11. Patch `World` disposal to remove scene-attached sky/sun/lights/motes/NPCs/creatures/enemies; patch `World` quality to use `game.qualityLevel`, and path to `game.setCheckpoint`.
12. Implement boss orchestration: auto-trigger Coloso/Varok/Custodio, Varok/Custodio post-dialogues before quest completion, altar-triggered Convergence, ending dialogue and final screens.
13. Export `SHOP` from `MenuExtra` or define matching price map in `Game.buyItem`.
14. Run `npm run build`, fix errors, then `npm run dev`/`npm run preview` on 3002 and Playwright verify screenshots and interactions.
15. End-to-end test quest chain, boss fights, capture, save/load, both endings, mobile landscape.
16. Replace `README.md` with real game documentation, setup, controls, features, Android/browser limitations, honest GOTY framing; add font OFL license files.
17. Commit work when complete (repo currently uncommitted).

## Relevant Files
- `src/core/Game.js`: missing; central state, renderer/loop, save, world orchestration, all UI/quest hooks.
- `src/main.js`: missing; bootstraps Game/UI/audio.
- `src/world/World.js`: terrain, structures, spawns, interactions, colliders; needs disposal/quality/checkpoint patches.
- `src/entities/Player.js`: player mechanics; needs class-bonus and creature-target patches.
- `src/ui/UI.js`: core UI/HUD/dialogue/minimap; needs `refreshHUD`, `captureFlash`, settings/title overlay fixes.
- `src/ui/MenuScreen.js`: pause menu core tabs; missing difficulty handler and no-save settings support.
- `src/ui/MenuExtra.js`: creatures/quests/map/settings/system/shop/help/credits; title overlay close bugs, shopOpen flag, `SHOP` export.
- `src/ui/TitleScreen.js`: needs “Start Game” aria-label.
- `src/core/Dialogue.js`: dialogue interpreter; patch to notify Game on dialogue start/state.
- `src/data/quests.js`: add `despertar.next`; boss step positions/arenas drive orchestration.
- `src/data/dialogues.js`: NPC/scripted trees; Varok/Custodio/Convergence ending actions.
- `src/data/zones.js`: terrain/layout/NPC/waypoint/portal/interactable/boss-arena data.
- `src/ui/EndScreens.js`: death/ending/credits screens and callbacks.
- `src/fx/Effects.js`: particle/projectile/aura APIs used by Game loop and cleanup.
- `src/audio/AudioEngine.js`: adaptive music/SFX; call `init`, `setScene`, `setIntensity`, `sfx`, `setVolumes`.

## Important Context
- `package.json` scripts: `npm run dev` on port 3002, `npm run build` (`vite build --base ./`), `npm run preview`.
- `capture.sh` auto-starts only controls labeled exactly “Start”/“Play”/“Start Game”/“Play Game”; Spanish title buttons otherwise stall on title.
- `index.html` includes `#boot`, `#hud`, `#ui`, `#toast-layer`, `#cinematic`, `#subtitle`, `#skip-cinematic`, `#fade`, `#portrait-lock`; main canvas `#game`.
- Save schema expected: `name`, `className`, `appearance`, `stats`, `freePoints`, `level`, `xp`, `gold`, `essence`, `inventory`, `equipment`, `creatures[{id,level}]`, `activeCreature`, `flags`, `resonance`, `zone`, `position`, `discoveredWaypoints`, `playTime`, `difficulty`, plus serialized quests/ending/checkpoint.
- `QuestManager` auto-completes talk objectives on `notifyTalk`; call `notifyTalk` after dialogue closes. `wasJustCompleted` lasts 8s.
- Main quest auto-start next `next` after 1400 ms via `QuestManager.complete`.

- Boss flow: `coloso_raiz` at Vael arena; `varok` at fortress; `custodio_velo` at temple; `convergencia` at altar. Varok/custodio have pre/post dialogues; convergence post-combat triggers `SCRIPTED.ending`.

- `Player` uses `game.difficulty.taken`, `game.projectPoint`, `game.shakeCamera`, `game.hitStop`, `game.cameraYaw`, `game.cameraFocus`; ensure these exist.

- `Player.pos` is `THREE.Vector3`; UI expects `.x`, `.z`; HUD uses `game.world.zone`, `game.world.enemies/npcs/waypoints/portals/interactables/creatureSpawns`.
- `UI.getTerrainCanvas` uses raw hex color conversion and zone `heightAt/isWater/palette/bounds`.
- Repo is uncommitted; no successful build has been run yet.

Combate
275:

Pulsa atacar varias veces para encadenar un combo de tres golpes. El tercer golpe hace más daño y empuja. Esquivar consume aguante y te hace invulnerable durante un instante. Bloquear reduce el daño; si bloqueas justo en el momento del impacto, ejecutas un paro que aturde al enemigo y rellena aguante. La barra verde se agota: sin aguante no puedes esquivar ni bloquear.

278:
Resonancia y criaturas
279:

Debilita a una criatura por debajo de un tercio de su vida y pulsa Capturar. La probabilidad depende de su vida restante, tu suerte y la rareza. Las criaturas capturadas luchan a tu lado: invoca una y usa su habilidad con F. La esencia de resonancia las fortalece.

281:
282:
Progresión
283:

Sube de nivel con experiencia, reparte puntos de atributo y equipa armas, armaduras, cascos y amuletos. Cada atributo tiene un efecto medible: vitalidad, maná, aguante, daño, defensa, velocidad, poder mágico, crítico y captura. Las misiones principales avanzan la historia; las secundarias dan equipo único y lore.

Mapa y viaje
287:

Descubre santuarios acercándote a ellos. Desde el mapa puedes viajar entre santuarios descubiertos de la región actual, siempre fuera de combate. Los portales conectan Valdoria, Drakmor y Kansordore cuando la historia lo permite.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL”, a real, playable, original action-fantasy RPG for Android/browser (horizontal, Spanish from Spain) with 3 regions, combat, exploration, creature collection, customizable protagonist, story, UI, audio and high production ambition; GOTY is an aspiration, never a claimed award.

## Requirements
- Must be a real playable game, not a demo/design document/mockup.
- Original universe, characters, creatures, story, music and art; no existing IP.
- Regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats (Vida, Maná, Resistencia, Fuerza, Defensa, Velocidad, Inteligencia, Suerte) with measurable effects and equipment affecting appearance where viable.
- Mobile-first horizontal layout, usable touch controls, Android support; Spanish (Spain).
- Quality targets: gameplay, combat, story, characters, world, exploration, art, music/sound, animations, AI, UI, performance, accessibility, system depth, originality.
- Do not invent unsupported platform capabilities; explain limitations and provide best alternative.

## Decisions
- Build as a Vite + Three.js browser game with procedural 3D visuals, Web Audio music/SFX, Canvas UI/maps, localStorage saves.
- Use 3 separate zones loaded via portals rather than one continuous world.
- Stylized low-poly/toon 3D with procedural terrain, props, structures, characters and creatures to avoid external assets and licensing issues.
- Bundle fonts locally (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`) under `public/fonts`.
- Main systems: third-person camera, 3-hit melee combo, dodge i-frames, block/parry, stamina, two class skills, creature capture/summon/upgrade, equipment/attributes, quests/dialogues/choices, waypoints/fast travel, shop, accessibility, auto-save.
- Eight creatures: Lumifín, Bramiel, Grímpola, Brasal, Umbrino, Cineronte, Petreluz, Celemn.
- Three classes/juramentos: Guardián, Filo, Vidente.
- Main quest chain of 13 quests plus 5 side quests.
- Endings: open or close the Velo, with epilogue influenced by choices/resonance.
- UI orchestration split into multiple classes to avoid oversized single file.
- Settings/audio/menu from title use overlays; gameplay pause menu is a separate screen.
- Player/enemy/creature models built procedurally in `src/world/models.js`; visual equipment changes via mesh rebuild.
- Combat model: player melee arcs, enemy windup telegraphs, ranged projectiles, boss phases and telegraphed specials, creature ability mapping per creature id.
- Title backdrop will reuse procedural landscape/arch/sword staging; character creation gets a dedicated 3D preview stage.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected repo; it was essentially empty except agent scaffolding, `README.md`, `start.sh`, `capture.sh`.
- Created project scaffold: `package.json` (Three.js ^0.187.0, Vite ^8.3.5), `index.html`, favicon, local fonts.
- Downloaded and bundled `cinzel.woff2`, `cormorant.woff2`, `cormorant-italic.woff2` into `public/fonts`.
- Wrote full CSS design system and responsive/touch/UI styles in `src/style.css`.
- Implemented utilities: `src/utils/math.js`, `src/utils/noise.js`.
- Implemented data: items/equipment/classes/difficulties, creatures, enemies/spawns, quests, zones/terrain/layouts, dialogues including story scenes and endings.
- Implemented systems: `AudioEngine` (procedural adaptive music + SFX), `Save`, `Input` (keyboard/mouse/touch/gamepad), `QuestManager`, `stats.js`.
- Implemented UI core: boot, HUD, joystick/buttons, dialogue typewriter, minimap/full map, toasts, banners, target/boss bars, cinematic subtitles, damage numbers.
- Implemented `TitleScreen`, `CreationScreen`, `MenuScreen` core tabs (personaje/equipo/inventario), `MenuExtra` (criaturas/misiones/mapa/ajustes/sistema/shop/help/credits).
- Wrote procedural SVG portraits in `src/ui/portraits.js`.
- Created `src/ui/EndScreens.js` with death, ending and credits screens.
- Created `src/core/Dialogue.js` interpreting NPC/scripted dialogue nodes, choices, actions, function transitions and close callbacks.
- Created `src/world/models.js` with procedural humanoid, enemy, creature, sword, name-tag and glow model factories.
- Created `src/fx/Effects.js` with particle bursts, ground rings, slashes, beams, auras and projectiles.
- Created `src/entities/Player.js` with movement/camera-relative control, combo attacks, dodge i-frames, block/parry, class skills, creature abilities/passives, potions, capture targeting, status effects, death and procedural animations.
- Created `src/entities/Enemy.js` with idle/chase/return AI, windup attacks, ranged/fan projectiles, boss phases, specials, stuns, slows, burn, knockback, loot/death hooks and animation.
- Created `src/entities/Creature.js`: wild creature wander/flee behavior, HP/damage, capture state, respawn, name tags, motes, death/removal.
- Created `src/entities/NPC.js`: procedural NPC model, role styling, name tag, idle animation, player-facing behavior.
- Created `src/world/World.js`: sky shader, lights, fog, terrain vertex colors, water/lava/cloud planes, instanced trees/rocks/grass/flowers/crystals, zone-specific villages/ruins/camps/fortress/sanctuary/beacon/library/city/temple/altar, waypoints, portals, interactables, NPC/creature/enemy spawning, boss spawn, collision resolution, focus prompts, discovery, respawns, ambient animation and disposal.
- Ran `npm install` successfully (Three.js + Vite installed).
- Audited all existing modules and interfaces in detail; no successful build has been run yet.
- Started patching support modules: `src/core/stats.js` now imports `JURAMENTOS` from `../data/items.js` to support class bonuses.

### Active
- Need to create `src/core/Game.js` implementing all UI/quest/dialogue hooks and end-to-end flow.
- Need to create `src/main.js` bootstrapping `Game` and UI/audio.
- Need to run build and fix syntax/module/reference errors across new modules.
- Need to start server on port 3002 and use Playwright to verify title, creation, HUD, combat, menus, dialogue, mobile layout.
- Need to verify save/load, quest progression, boss flow, creature capture, endings end-to-end.
- Need to fix known pending UI/data issues below.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Finish support-module patches: add `effectiveStats(stats, className)` in `src/core/stats.js`; use it in `Player` and `MenuScreen`; add class-bonus application.
2. Patch `Player.performHit()` to also damage `world.creatureSpawns` so capture is achievable.
3. Patch `World` disposal to remove scene-attached sky/sun/lights/motes/NPCs/creatures/enemies; use `game.qualityLevel`; call `game.setCheckpoint` on waypoint discovery.
4. Fix `UI.openSettings(from)` to pass `from === 'title'` into `MenuScreen.open`; reset stale `menuScreen.el`/shop state on `UI.showTitle`; call `titleScreen.hide()`/`creationScreen.hide()`; add `refreshHUD()` and `captureFlash()`.
5. Fix `TitleScreen` “Nueva partida” aria-label to include “Start Game” for `capture.sh` auto-start.
6. Fix `MenuExtra` help/credits close handlers from title (avoid duplicating title); add missing `difficulty` action handler in `MenuScreen`; allow settings render with no save.
7. Add `despertar.next = 'sombras_ribera'` so declining “prepare” does not dead-end the main quest.
8. Create `src/core/Game.js`: renderer/camera/loop, title/creation stages, save/load, zone loading/transitions, quest hooks, dialogue flow, interactions, combat orchestration, bosses, shop, settings, endings, retry/death, auto-save.
9. Create `src/main.js` bootstrapping `Game` and UI/audio; initialize audio on first gesture; await fonts; handle boot/errors.
10. Implement boss orchestration: auto-trigger Coloso/Varok/Custodio, Varok/Custodio post-dialogues before quest completion, altar-triggered Convergence, ending dialogue and final screens.
11. Run `npm run build`, fix errors, then `npm run dev`/`npm run preview` on 3002 and Playwright verify screenshots and interactions.
12. End-to-end test quest chain, boss fights, capture, save/load, both endings, mobile landscape.
13. Replace `README.md` with real game documentation, setup, controls, features, Android/browser limitations, honest GOTY framing; add font OFL license files.
14. Commit work when complete (repo currently uncommitted).

## Relevant Files
- `src/core/Game.js`: missing; central state, renderer/loop, save, world orchestration, all UI/quest hooks.
- `src/main.js`: missing; bootstraps Game/UI/audio.
- `src/world/World.js`: terrain, structures, spawns, interactions, colliders; needs disposal/quality/checkpoint patches.
- `src/entities/Player.js`: player mechanics; needs class-bonus and creature-target patches.
- `src/ui/UI.js`: core UI/HUD/dialogue/minimap; needs `refreshHUD`, `captureFlash`, settings/title overlay fixes.
- `src/ui/MenuScreen.js`: pause menu core tabs; missing difficulty handler and no-save settings support.
- `src/ui/MenuExtra.js`: creatures/quests/map/settings/system/shop/help/credits; title overlay close bugs, shopOpen flag, shop price map.
- `src/ui/TitleScreen.js`: needs “Start Game” aria-label.
- `src/core/stats.js`: class-bonus helper to add; currently imports `JURAMENTOS`.
- `src/core/Dialogue.js`: dialogue interpreter; patch to notify Game on dialogue start/state.
- `src/data/quests.js`: add `despertar.next`; boss step positions/arenas drive orchestration.
- `src/data/dialogues.js`: NPC/scripted trees; Varok/Custodio/Convergence ending actions.
- `src/data/zones.js`: terrain/layout/NPC/waypoint/portal/interactable/boss-arena data.
- `src/ui/EndScreens.js`: death/ending/credits screens and callbacks.

## Important Context
- `package.json` scripts: `npm run dev` on port 3002, `npm run build` (`vite build --base ./`), `npm run preview`.
- `capture.sh` auto-starts only controls labeled exactly “Start”/“Play”/“Start Game”/“Play Game”; Spanish title buttons otherwise stall on title.
- `index.html` includes `#boot`, `#hud`, `#ui`, `#toast-layer`, `#cinematic`, `#subtitle`, `#skip-cinematic`, `#fade`, `#portrait-lock`; main canvas `#game`.
- Save schema expected: `name`, `className`, `appearance`, `stats`, `freePoints`, `level`, `xp`, `gold`, `essence`, `inventory`, `equipment`, `creatures[{id,level}]`, `activeCreature`, `flags`, `resonance`, `zone`, `position`, `discoveredWaypoints`, `playTime`, `difficulty`, plus serialized quests/ending/checkpoint.
- `QuestManager` auto-completes talk objectives on `notifyTalk`; call `notifyTalk` after dialogue closes. `wasJustCompleted` lasts 8s.
- Main quest auto-start next `next` after 1400 ms via `QuestManager.complete`.
- `gem` flow: `ruinas_vael` completion flag `jar_obtained`; `senor_ceniza` flag `varok_defeated`; portals require these.
- Boss flow: `coloso_raiz` at Vael arena; `varok` at fortress; `custodio_velo` at temple; `convergencia` at altar. Varok/custodio have pre/post dialogues; convergence post-combat triggers `SCRIPTED.ending`.
- `MenuExtra` shop prices internal `SHOP` array (potion_vida 30, potion_mana 35, elixir_alba 140, esencia_resonancia 60); Game needs matching price map for `buyItem`.
- `Player` uses `game.difficulty.taken`, `game.projectPoint`, `game.shakeCamera`, `game.hitStop`, `game.cameraYaw`, `game.cameraFocus`; ensure these exist.
- `Player.projectPoint` usage is inconsistent: Player heals spread it, Enemy reads `.x/.y`; returning an array with `.x/.y` properties satisfies both.
- `Player.passiveMods` includes `mp` multiplier; `recalc` applies creature passives.
- `World.resolveCollision(x,z,r)` returns `{x,z}`; `World.bossArenaLock` expected `{x,z,radius}`.
- `Player.pos` is `THREE.Vector3`; UI expects `.x`, `.z`; HUD uses `game.world.zone`, `game.world.enemies/npcs/waypoints/portals/interactables/creatureSpawns`.
- `UI.getTerrainCanvas` uses raw hex color conversion and zone `heightAt/isWater/palette/bounds`.
- Repo is uncommitted; no successful build has been run yet.
- Fonts are under `public/fonts`; CSS references `/fonts/...`; `vite build --base ./` may preserve absolute paths and break subpath deployment. Consider moving fonts to `src/assets/fonts` with relative CSS imports.
- `World` constructor expects `game.scene`, `game.settings`, `game.flags`, `game.save`, `game.player`, `game.fx`, `game.ui`, `game.quests`, `game.toast`, `game.audio`, `game.autoSave`, `game.state`, `game.isWaypointDiscovered`, `game.projectPoint`.
- `World` spawns creatures at fixed positions in `CREATURE_SPAWNS`; enemies via `ZONE_SPAWNS`; bosses via `world.spawnBoss(id)`.
- `World.update` discovers waypoints, calls `quests.notifyGoto`, drives prompts and respawns; interaction handling must live in `Game.interact()`.
- `Creature` flees when player approaches and must be damaged to ≤45% HP before capture; `Player.performHit` currently only loops `world.enemies`.
- `NPC` expects `createHumanoid` invocation with color/appearance/npcStyle; `dialogueFor` maps NPC ids in `data/dialogues.js`.
- `DialogueSystem.close()` calls `game.ui.hideDialogue()` then `ctx.onClose` after 30 ms; `Game.onDialogueClosed(npc, ctx)` must restore state and notify quests.
- `TitleScreen.show()` always calls `game.setTitleScene()`; that method must unload any running world/player cleanly and build the title backdrop.
- `MenuScreen.close()` calls `game.returnToTitle()` when opened with `fromTitle = true`, otherwise `game.closeMenu()`; `Game.closeMenu` should clean DOM directly to avoid recursion.
- `EndScreens.showEnding` buttons call `game.resumeAfterEnding()` / `game.returnToTitle(true)`; `showCredits` can re-open ending based on `flags.ending`.

182:       if (this.attackTimer > 0) this.facing = dampAngle(this.facing, yaw + Math.PI, 16, dt)
183:     }
184: 
185:     this.clampPosition()
186:     const zone = game.world?.zone
187:     const ground = zone ? zone.heightAt(this.pos.x, this.pos.z) : 0
188:     this.pos.y = ground + .03
189:     this.mesh.position.copy(this.pos)
190:     this.mesh.rotation.y = this.facing
191: 
192:     // Animación de ataque
193:     if (this.attackTimer > 0) {
194:       this.attackTimer -= dt
195:       const spent = (this.comboIndex === 2 ? .46 : .34) - this.attackTimer
196:       if (!this.attackDidHit && spent >= this.attackHitAt) {
197:         this.attackDidHit = true
198:         this.performHit()
199:       }
200:       if (this.attackTimer <= 0) {
201:         this.attackTimer = 0
202:         if (this.comboQueued && this.comboIndex < 2) this.startAttack(true)
203:         else this.attackCD = .08
204:       }
205:     } else if (this.comboTimer > 0) {
206:       this.comboTimer -= dt
207:       if (this.comboTimer <= 0) this.comboIndex = 0
208:     }
209: 
210:     if (this.blocking && this.parryReady > 0) this.parryReady -= dt
211:     if (this.iFrames > 0) this.iFrames -= dt
212:     if (this.dodgeTime > 0) {
213:       this.dodgeTime -= dt
214:       if (this.dodgeTime <= 0) this.dodgeTime = 0
215:     }
216: 
217:     // Regeneración
218:     this.outOfCombat += dt
219:     if (this.outOfCombat > 4.5) {
220:       this.hp = Math.min(this.derived.hp, this.hp + this.derived.hpRegen * dt)
221:       const regen = this.passiveMods().regen + (this.save.activeCreature === 'lumifin' ? 2 : 0)
222:       if (regen) this.hp = Math.min(this.derived.hp, this.hp + regen * dt)
223:     }
224:     this.mp = Math.min(this.derived.mp, this.mp + this.derived.manaRegen * dt)
225:     this.stamina = Math.min(this.derived.stamina, this.stamina + this.derived.staminaRegen * (this.blocking ? .18 : 1) * dt)
226: 
227:     this.updateCompanion(dt)
228:     this.updateAura()
229:     this.updateCaptureTarget()
230:     this.updateBrasalAura(dt)
231:     this.animate(dt)
232:   }

250:   clampPosition() {
251:     const world = this.game.world
252:     if (!world) return
253:     const zone = world.zone
254:     const b = zone.bounds - 4
255:     this.pos.x = clamp(this.pos.x, -b, b)
256:     this.pos.z = clamp(this.pos.z, -b, b)
257:     if (zone.isWater?.(this.pos.x, this.pos.z)) {
258:       const h = zone.heightAt(this.pos.x, this.pos.z)
259:       if (h < (zone.id === 'drakmor' ? -1.8 : -2.5)) {
260:         this.pos.x -= this.velocity.x * .01
261:         this.pos.z -= this.velocity.z * .01
262:       }
263:     }
264:     const c = world.resolveCollision?.(this.pos.x, this.pos.z, .55)
265:     if (c) { this.pos.x = c.x; this.pos.z = c.z }
266:     if (world.bossArenaLock) {
267:       const a = world.bossArenaLock
268:       const d = Math.hypot(this.pos.x - a.x, this.pos.z - a.z)
269:       if (d > a.radius) {
270:         const k = a.radius / d
271:         this.pos.x = a.x + (this.pos.x - a.x) * k
272:         this.pos.z = a.z + (this.pos.z - a.z) * k
273:       }
274:     }
275:   }

283:       const d = Math.hypot(c.pos.x - this.pos.x, c.pos.z - this.pos.z)
284:       if (d < bestD && c.hp / c.maxHp <= .45) { best = c; bestD = d }
285:     }
286:     this.captureTarget = best

289:   updateCompanion(dt) {
290:     if (!this.companion) return
291:     const t = performance.now() * .001
292:     const side = Math.sin(t * .7 + this.companion.userData.phase) * .45
293:     const targetX = this.pos.x + Math.cos(this.facing) * this.companionOffset.z + Math.sin(this.facing) * (1.2 + side)
294:     const targetZ = this.pos.z - Math.sin(this.facing) * this.companionOffset.z + Math.cos(this.facing) * (1.2 + side)
295:     const ground = this.game.world?.zone?.heightAt(targetX, targetZ) ?? 0
296:     const targetY = ground + 1.15 + Math.sin(t * 2.2 + (this.companion.userData.phase || 0)) * .12
297:     this.companion.position.x += (targetX - this.companion.position.x) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.4)
298:     this.companion.position.z += (targetZ - this.companion.position.z) * Math.min(1, dt * 3.4)
299:     this.companion.position.y += (targetY - this.companion.position.y) * Math.min(1, dt * 4.2)
300:     this.companion.rotation.y = dampAngle(this.companion.rotation.y, this.facing, 6, dt)
301:     const rig = this.companion.userData.rig
302:     if (rig?.wings) rig.wings.forEach((w, i) => { w.rotation.z = Math.sin(t * 8 + i * Math.PI) * .35 })
303:     if (rig?.body) rig.body.position.y = Math.sin(t * 2.4) * .04

326:   animate(dt, frozen = false) {

329:     const t = performance.now() * .001
330:     let speed = frozen ? 0 : this.moveSpeed
331:     if (this.dodgeTime > 0) speed = 12
332:     this.walkPhase += dt * (2.4 + speed * .72)
333:     const swing = Math.sin(this.walkPhase) * Math.min(.75, speed * .07)
334:     const bob = Math.abs(Math.sin(this.walkPhase * 2)) * Math.min(.06, speed * .006)
335:     rig.body.position.y = bob + (this.dead ? -.35 : 0)
336:     rig.legL.rotation.x = swing
337:     rig.legR.rotation.x = -swing
338:     rig.armL.rotation.x = -swing * .7
339:     rig.armR.rotation.x = swing * .35
340:     rig.armL.rotation.z = -.08
341:     rig.armR.rotation.z = .08
342:     rig.body.rotation.z = this.dodgeTime > 0 ? .25 : 0
343:     rig.head.rotation.y = Math.sin(t * .7) * .04
344:     rig.head.rotation.x = this.blocking ? .12 : 0
345: 
346:     if (this.attackTimer > 0) {
347:       const total = this.comboIndex === 2 ? .46 : .34
348:       const p = 1 - this.attackTimer / total
349:       const ang = this.comboIndex === 2
350:         ? -2.3 + p * 3.6
351:         : (this.comboIndex === 1 ? 1.8 - p * 3.4 : -1.4 + p * 2.9)
352:       rig.armR.rotation.x = ang
353:       rig.armR.rotation.z = -.45 + Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * .9
354:       rig.body.rotation.y = Math.sin(p * Math.PI) * (this.comboIndex === 2 ? .55 : .32)
355:     } else {
356:       rig.body.rotation.y = 0
357:     }
358:     if (this.blocking) {

360:       rig.armL.rotation.z = .8
361:       rig.armR.rotation.x = -.45

363:     if (this.hurtFlash > 0) {
364:       this.hurtFlash -= dt
365:       this.mesh.traverse(o => { if (o.material?.emissive) o.material.emissive.setHex(0x6a1a14) })
366:     } else if (this.mesh.userData.lastFlash) {

381:   startAttack(queued = false) {
382:     if (this.dead || this.attackCD > 0 || this.attackTimer > 0) return
383:     if (this.stamina < 5) { this.game.toast('Sin aguante para atacar.', '⚠'); return }
384:     if (!queued) {
385:       if (this.comboTimer > 0) this.comboIndex = (this.comboIndex + 1) % 3
386:       else this.comboIndex = 0
387:     } else this.comboIndex++
388:     this.stamina -= 5
389:     this.attackTimer = this.comboIndex === 2 ? .46 : .34
390:     this.attackHitAt = this.comboIndex === 2 ? .22 : .13
391:     this.attackDidHit = false
392:     this.comboQueued = false

399:   queueCombo() {

404:     return false

407:   performHit() {
408:     const game = this.game
409:     const reach = this.comboIndex === 2 ? 3.1 : 2.45
410:     const arc = this.comboIndex === 2 ? Math.PI * .9 : Math.PI * .62
411:     const dmgBase = this.derived.attack * (this.comboIndex === 2 ? 1.85 : this.comboIndex === 1 ? 1.12 : 1)
412:     const origin = new THREE.Vector3(this.pos.x, this.pos.y + 1, this.pos.z)
413:     const dir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(this.facing), 0, Math.cos(this.facing))
414:     game.fx.slash(this.pos, this.facing, this.comboIndex === 2 ? 0xffc46a : 0xffe6c0, this.comboIndex === 2 ? 2 : 1.45)
415:     let hits = 0
416:     for (const enemy of game.world?.enemies || []) {
417:       if (!enemy.alive) continue
418:       const to = new THREE.Vector3(enemy.pos.x - this.pos.x, 0, enemy.pos.z - this.pos.z)
419:       const d = to.length()
420:       if (d > reach + enemy.def.radius) continue
421:       to.normalize()
422:       const dot = dir.dot(to)
423:       if (dot < Math.cos(arc / 2)) continue
424:       const crit = Math.random() < this.derived.crit
425:       let dmg = dmgBase * (crit ? this.derived.critMult : 1) * (0.93 + Math.random() * .14)
426:       if (enemy.def.boss) dmg *= .92
427:       enemy.takeDamage(Math.round(dmg), { crit, source: 'player', dir: to.clone(), combo: this.comboIndex })
428:       hits++
429:     }
430:     if (hits) {
431:       this.outOfCombat = 0
432:       game.hitStop = Math.max(game.hitStop, this.comboIndex === 2 ? .11 : .055)
433:       game.shakeCamera?.(this.comboIndex === 2 ? .24 : .12, .18)
434:       game.audio?.sfx('hit')
435:       if (this.comboIndex === 2) game.fx.ring(new THREE.Vector3(this.pos.x, this.pos.y, this.pos.z), 0xffd28a, 2.8, { life: .45 })
436:     }
437:   }

439:   dodge() {
440:     if (this.dead || this.dodgeTime > 0 || this.stamina < this.derived.dodgeCost) return
441:     const axis = this.game.input.axis()
442:     let dx = 0, dz = 0
443:     if (Math.abs(axis.x) + Math.abs(axis.y) > .1) {
444:       const yaw = this.game.cameraYaw
445:       const forward = { x: -Math.sin(yaw), z: -Math.cos(yaw) }
446:       const right = { x: Math.cos(yaw), z: -Math.sin(yaw) }
447:       dx = right.x * axis.x + forward.x * (-axis.y)
448:       dz = right.z * axis.x + forward.z * (-axis.y)
449:     } else {
450:       dx = Math.sin(this.facing); dz = Math.cos(this.facing)
451:     }
452:     const len = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1
453:     this.dodgeDir.set(dx / len, 0, dz / len)
454:     this.stamina -= this.derived.dodgeCost
455:     this.dodgeTime = .28
456:     this.iFrames = .34
457:     this.outOfCombat = 0
458:     this.game.audio?.sfx('dodge')
459:     this.game.fx.burst(new THREE.Vector3(this.pos.x, this.pos.y + .5, this.pos.z), 0xd8e8ff, 12, { speed: 1.5, life: .4 })

779:   buildProps() {
780:     const props = this.zone.props

782:     let treeCount = props.treeCount
783:     let rockCount = props.rockCount
784:     let flowerCount = props.flowerCount
785:     let grassCount = props.grassCount
786:     if (this.quality === 'baja') { treeCount = Math.round(treeCount * .6); grassCount = Math.round(grassCount * .4); flowerCount = Math.round(flowerCount * .5) }
787:     if (this.quality === 'media') { treeCount = Math.round(treeCount * .8); grassCount = Math.round(grassCount * .75) }
788: 
789:     // Árboles: tronco y copa instanciados
790:     const style = props.treeStyle
791:     const trunkMat = std(style === 'dead' ? 0x3d302b : style === 'celestial' ? 0x8b899c : 0x5a4028, { roughness: .95 })
792:     const leafMat = style === 'dead'
793:       ? std(0x3a2f2c)
794:       : style === 'celestial'
795:         ? std(0x8fc5cf, { emissive: p.accent, emissiveIntensity: .13 })
796:         : std(p.ground2, { roughness: .95 })
797:     const trunkGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.16, .28, 2.8, 5)
798:     const leafGeo = style === 'dead' ? new THREE.ConeGeometry(.9, 2.2, 4) : new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1.55, 0)
799:     const trunks = new THREE.InstancedMesh(trunkGeo, trunkMat, treeCount)
800:     const leaves = new THREE.InstancedMesh(leafGeo, leafMat, treeCount)
801:     trunks.castShadow = leaves.castShadow = this.quality !== 'baja'
802:     trunks.receiveShadow = leaves.receiveShadow = true
803:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
804:     let ti = 0
805:     let tries = 0
806:     while (ti < treeCount && tries < treeCount * 14) {
807:       tries++
808:       const x = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.84
809:       const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.84
810:       if (this.isReserved(x, z, 1.5) || this.isWaterDeep(x, z)) continue
811:       const h = this.zone.heightAt(x, z)
812:       if (h > 11) continue
813:       const s = .75 + this.rand() * .85
814:       dummy.position.set(x, h + 1.4 * s, z)
815:       dummy.rotation.y = this.rand() * TAU
816:       dummy.scale.set(s * (.8 + this.rand() * .3), s, s * (.8 + this.rand() * .3))
817:       dummy.updateMatrix()
818:       trunks.setMatrixAt(ti, dummy.matrix)
819:       dummy.position.y = h + (style === 'dead' ? 2.8 : 2.9) * s
820:       dummy.rotation.z = style === 'dead' ? (this.rand() - .5) * .3 : 0
821:       dummy.updateMatrix()
822:       leaves.setMatrixAt(ti, dummy.matrix)
823:       ti++
824:     }
825:     trunks.count = leaves.count = ti
826:     this.group.add(trunks, leaves)
827:     this.treeMeshes = [trunks, leaves]
828: 
829:     // Rocas
830:     const rockGeo = new THREE.DodecahedronGeometry(.8, 0)
831:     const rockMat = std(p.rock, { roughness: 1 })
832:     const rocks = new THREE.InstancedMesh(rockGeo, rockMat, rockCount)
833:     rocks.castShadow = rocks.receiveShadow = this.quality !== 'baja'
834:     let ri = 0
835:     tries = 0
836:     while (ri < rockCount && tries < rockCount * 12) {
837:       tries++
838:       const x = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.8
839:       const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.8
840:       if (this.isReserved(x, z, 1) || this.isWaterDeep(x, z)) continue
841:       const s = .5 + this.rand() * 1.8
842:       dummy.position.set(x, this.zone.heightAt(x, z) + s * .22, z)
843:       dummy.rotation.set(this.rand() * TAU, this.rand() * TAU, this.rand() * TAU)
844:       dummy.scale.set(s, s * (.55 + this.rand() * .5), s)
845:       dummy.updateMatrix()
846:       rocks.setMatrixAt(ri, dummy.matrix)
847:       ri++
848:     }
849:     rocks.count = ri
850:     this.group.add(rocks)

852:     // Hierba
853:     if (grassCount > 0) {
854:       const grassGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(.16, .5)
855:       grassGeo.translate(0, .25, 0)
856:       const grassMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
857:         color: this.zoneId === 'drakmor' ? 0x4a3a2d : this.zoneId === 'kansordore' ? 0x7f8e91 : 0x5f7a45,
858:         roughness: 1, side: THREE.DoubleSide
859:       })
860:       const grass = new THREE.InstancedMesh(grassGeo, grassMat, grassCount)
861:       let gi = 0
862:       tries = 0
863:       while (gi < grassCount && tries < grassCount * 10) {
864:         tries++
865:         const x = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.9
866:         const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.9
867:         if (this.isReserved(x, z, .5) || this.isWaterDeep(x, z)) continue
868:         dummy.position.set(x, this.zone.heightAt(x, z), z)
869:         dummy.rotation.set(0, this.rand() * TAU, (this.rand() - .5) * .12)
870:         dummy.scale.setScalar(.7 + this.rand() * .8)
871:         dummy.updateMatrix()
872:         grass.setMatrixAt(gi, dummy.matrix)
873:         gi++
874:       }
875:       grass.count = gi
876:       grass.receiveShadow = true
877:       this.group.add(grass)
878:     }

880:     // Flores / motas de luz
881:     if (flowerCount > 0) {
882:       const positions = new Float32Array(flowerCount * 3)
883:       const cols = new Float32Array(flowerCount * 3)
884:       const col = new THREE.Color(p.particle)
885:       let fi = 0
886:       tries = 0
887:       while (fi < flowerCount && tries < flowerCount * 10) {
888:         tries++
889:         const x = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.8
890:         const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.8
891:         if (this.isReserved(x, z, .6) || this.isWaterDeep(x, z)) continue
892:         positions[fi * 3] = x
893:         positions[fi * 3 + 1] = this.zone.heightAt(x, z) + .25
894:         positions[fi * 3 + 2] = z
895:         cols[fi * 3] = col.r; cols[fi * 3 + 1] = col.g; cols[fi * 3 + 2] = col.b
896:         fi++
897:       }
898:       const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry()
899:       geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3))
900:       geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(cols, 3))
901:       const flowers = new THREE.Points(geo, new THREE.PointsMaterial({
902:         size: .19, vertexColors: true, transparent: true, opacity: .9,
903:         depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending
904:       }))
905:       flowers.count = fi
906:       this.group.add(flowers)

909:     // Cristales
910:     if (props.crystals > 0) {
911:       const geo = new THREE.OctahedronGeometry(.55, 0)
912:       geo.scale(.55, 1.4, .55)
913:       const mat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
914:         color: this.zoneId === 'drakmor' ? 0x5d2b25 : 0x7d9db7,
915:         emissive: p.accent, emissiveIntensity: this.zoneId === 'drakmor' ? .4 : .22,
916:         roughness: .3, metalness: .4, flatShading: true
917:       })
918:       const crystals = new THREE.InstancedMesh(geo, mat, props.crystals)
919:       let ci = 0
920:       tries = 0
921:       while (ci < props.crystals && tries < props.crystals * 12) {
922:         tries++
923:         const x = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.75
924:         const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.75
925:         if (this.isReserved(x, z, .8) || this.isWaterDeep(x, z)) continue
926:         const s = .5 + this.rand() * 1.5
927:         dummy.position.set(x, this.zone.heightAt(x, z) + s * .35, z)
928:         dummy.rotation.set((this.rand() - .5) * .4, this.rand() * TAU, (this.rand() - .5) * .4)
929:         dummy.scale.setScalar(s)
930:         dummy.updateMatrix()
931:         crystals.setMatrixAt(ci, dummy.matrix)
932:         ci++

1032:   buildInteractable(def) {

1034:     const y = this.zone.heightAt(x, z)
1035:     const g = new THREE.Group()
1036:     g.position.set(x, y, z)
1037:     const obj = { def, type: def.type, pos: new THREE.Vector3(x, y, z), mesh: g, used: !!this.game.flags?.[`used_${def.id}`] }
1038:     const wood = std(0x5c4430)
1039:     const metal = std(0x8b7b55, { metalness: .45, roughness: .5 })
1040:     const stone = std(0x777263)
1041:     if (def.type === 'chest') {
1042:       g.add(box(1, .6, .68, wood, 0, .3, 0))
1043:       const lid = box(1.04, .24, .72, wood, 0, .67, -.02)
1044:       lid.geometry.translate(0, 0, .34)
1045:       lid.position.z = -.36
1046:       g.add(lid)
1047:       g.add(box(1.08, .08, .1, metal, 0, .62, .3))
1048:       g.add(box(.14, .2, .06, metal, 0, .48, .37))
1049:       const glowLight = new THREE.PointLight(0xffd78a, obj.used ? 0 : .45, 3)
1050:       glowLight.position.y = .8
1051:       g.add(glowLight)

275:

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build “LA ESPADA CELESTIAL”, a real, playable, original action-fantasy RPG for Android/browser (horizontal, Spanish from Spain) with 3 regions, combat, exploration, creature collection, customizable protagonist, story, UI, audio and high production ambition; GOTY is an aspiration, never a claimed award.

## Requirements
- Must be a real playable game, not a demo/design document/mockup.
- Original universe, characters, creatures, story, music and art; no existing IP.
- Regions: Valdoria, Drakmor, Kansordore.
- Required lore elements: Gema Celestial, Jarra de Origen, Lágrima de la Primera Brasa, Profecía de Jugador Cero, Convergencia Absoluta, Despertar, Resonancia, Velo, Ruptura, Ascensión.
- Customizable protagonist: name, face, hair, hair color, clothes, armor, helmet, accessories, weapons; stats with measurable effects; equipment affecting appearance where viable.
- Mobile-first horizontal layout, touch controls, Android support; Spanish (Spain).
- Quality targets across gameplay, combat, story, characters, world, exploration, art, music/sound, animations, AI, UI, performance, accessibility, system depth, originality.
- Do not invent unsupported platform capabilities; explain limitations and provide best alternative.

## Decisions
- Build as Vite + Three.js browser game with procedural 3D visuals, Web Audio music/SFX, Canvas UI/maps, localStorage saves.
- Three separate zones loaded via portals; stylized low-poly/toon 3D entirely procedural.
- Bundle fonts locally (`Cinzel`, `Cormorant Garamond`) under `public/fonts`.
- Main systems: third-person camera, 3-hit combo, dodge i-frames, block/parry, stamina, two class skills, creature capture/summon/upgrade, equipment/attributes, quests/dialogues/choices, waypoints/fast travel, shop, accessibility, auto-save.
- Eight creatures; three classes/juramentos; 13 main quests + 5 side quests.
- Two endings (open/close Velo) with epilogue influenced by choices/resonance.
- UI split across `UI`, `TitleScreen`, `CreationScreen`, `MenuScreen`, `MenuExtra`, `EndScreens`.
- Use procedural models in `src/world/models.js`; visual equipment changes via mesh rebuild.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created project scaffold: `package.json` (Three.js ^0.187.0, Vite ^8.3.5), `index.html`, favicon, local fonts.
- Wrote full CSS design system and responsive/touch/UI styles in `src/style.css`.
- Implemented utilities: `src/utils/math.js`, `src/utils/noise.js`.
- Implemented data: items/equipment/classes/difficulties, creatures, enemies/spawns, quests, zones/terrain/layouts, dialogues including story scenes and endings.
- Implemented systems: `AudioEngine`, `Save`, `Input`, `QuestManager`, `stats.js`.
- Implemented UI core: boot, HUD, joystick/buttons, dialogue typewriter, minimap/full map, toasts, banners, target/boss bars, cinematic subtitles, damage numbers.
- Implemented `TitleScreen`, `CreationScreen`, `MenuScreen`, `MenuExtra`, procedural portraits, `EndScreens`, `Dialogue`.
- Implemented `models.js`, `Effects.js`, `Player.js`, `Enemy.js`, `Creature.js`, `NPC.js`, `World.js`.

407:   performHit() {
408:     const game = this.game
409:     const reach = this.comboIndex === 2 ? 3.1 : 2.45
410:     const arc = this.comboIndex === 2 ? Math.PI * .9 : Math.PI * .62
411:     const dmgBase = this.derived.attack * (this.comboIndex === 2 ? 1.85 : this.comboIndex === 1 ? 1.12 : 1)
412:     const origin = new THREE.Vector3(this.pos.x, this.pos.y + 1, this.pos.z)
413:     const dir = new THREE.Vector3(Math.sin(this.facing), 0, Math.cos(this.facing))
414:     game.fx.slash(this.pos, this.facing, this.comboIndex === 2 ? 0xffc46a : 0xffe6c0, this.comboIndex === 2 ? 2 : 1.45)
415:     let hits = 0
416:     for (const enemy of game.world?.enemies || []) {
417:       if (!enemy.alive) continue
418:       const to = new THREE.Vector3(enemy.pos.x - this.pos.x, 0, enemy.pos.z - this.pos.z)
419:       const d = to.length()
420:       if (d > reach + enemy.def.radius) continue
421:       to.normalize()
422:       const dot = dir.dot(to)
423:       if (dot < Math.cos(arc / 2)) continue
424:       const crit = Math.random() < this.derived.crit
425:       let dmg = dmgBase * (crit ? this.derived.critMult : 1) * (0.93 + Math.random() * .14)
426:       if (enemy.def.boss) dmg *= .92
427:       enemy.takeDamage(Math.round(dmg), { crit, source: 'player', dir: to.clone(), combo: this.comboIndex })
428:       hits++
429:     }
430:     // Las criaturas salvajes también pueden ser debilitadas con la espada.
431:     for (const creature of game.world?.creatureSpawns || []) {
432:       if (creature.caught || creature.dead) continue
433:       const to = new THREE.Vector3(creature.pos.x - this.pos.x, 0, creature.pos.z - this.pos.z)
434:       const d = to.length()
435:       if (d > reach + creature.radius) continue
436:       to.normalize()
437:       if (dir.dot(to) < Math.cos(arc / 2)) continue
438:       const crit = Math.random() < this.derived.crit
439:       const dmg = dmgBase * (crit ? this.derived.critMult : 1) * (0.9 + Math.random() * .12)
440:       creature.takeDamage(Math.round(dmg), { crit })
441:       hits++
442:     }
443:     if (hits) {
444:       this.outOfCombat = 0
445:       game.hitStop = Math.max(game.hitStop, this.comboIndex === 2 ? .11 : .055)
446:       game.shakeCamera?.(this.comboIndex === 2 ? .24 : .12, .18)
447:       game.audio?.sfx('hit')

779:   buildProps() {
780:     const props = this.zone.props
781:     const p = this.zone.palette
782:     let treeCount = props.treeCount
783:     let rockCount = props.rockCount
784:     let flowerCount = props.flowerCount
785:     let grassCount = props.grassCount
786:     if (this.quality === 'baja') { treeCount = Math.round(treeCount * .6); grassCount = Math.round(grassCount * .4); flowerCount = Math.round(flowerCount * .5) }
787:     if (this.quality === 'media') { treeCount = Math.round(treeCount * .8); grassCount = Math.round(grassCount * .75) }
788: 
789:     // Árboles: tronco y copa instanciados
790:     const style = props.treeStyle
791:     const trunkMat = std(style === 'dead' ? 0x3d302b : style === 'celestial' ? 0x8b899c : 0x5a4028, { roughness: .95 })
792:     const leafMat = style === 'dead'
793:       ? std(0x3a2f2c)
794:       : style === 'celestial'
795:         ? std(0x8fc5cf, { emissive: p.accent, emissiveIntensity: .13 })
796:         : std(p.ground2, { roughness: .95 })
797:     const trunkGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(.16, .28, 2.8, 5)
798:     const leafGeo = style === 'dead' ? new THREE.ConeGeometry(.9, 2.2, 4) : new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(1.55, 0)
799:     const trunks = new THREE.InstancedMesh(trunkGeo, trunkMat, treeCount)
800:     const leaves = new THREE.InstancedMesh(leafGeo, leafMat, treeCount)
801:     trunks.castShadow = leaves.castShadow = this.quality !== 'baja'
802:     trunks.receiveShadow = leaves.receiveShadow = true
803:     const dummy = new THREE.Object3D()
804:     let ti = 0
805:     let tries = 0
806:     while (ti < treeCount && tries < treeCount * 14) {
807:       tries++
808:       const x = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.84
809:       const z = (this.rand() - .5) * this.zone.bounds * 1.84
810:       if (this.isReserved(x, z, 1.5) || this.isWaterDeep(x, z)) continue
811:       const h = this.zone.heightAt(x, z)
812:       if (h > 11) continue
813:       const s = .75 + this.rand() * .85
814:       dummy.position.set(x, h + 1.4 * s, z)
815:       dummy.rotation.y = this.rand() * TAU

1159:   applyInteractableState(obj) {
1160:     const used = obj.used
1161:     if (obj.type === 'chest') {
1162:       if (obj.lid) obj.lid.rotation.x = used ? -1.05 : 0
1163:       if (obj.light) obj.light.intensity = used ? 0 : .45
1164:     } else if (obj.type === 'ore') {
1165:       obj.mesh.visible = !used
1166:     } else if (obj.type === 'herb') {
1167:       obj.mesh.visible = !used
1168:     } else if (obj.type === 'memory') {
1169:       if (obj.glass) obj.glass.visible = !used
1170:     } else if (obj.type === 'seal') {
1171:       if (obj.core) obj.core.material.opacity = used ? .2 : .7
1172:     } else if (obj.type === 'brazier' || obj.type === 'beacon') {
1173:       if (obj.flame) obj.flame.visible = used
1174:       if (obj.light) obj.light.intensity = used ? (obj.type === 'beacon' ? 2 : 1.6) : 0
1175:       if (used && obj.flame && !this.flames.some(f => f.mesh === obj.flame)) this.flames.push({ mesh: obj.flame, base: obj.type === 'beacon' ? .9 : .5, speed: 1.8 })
1176:     }
1177:   }

Combate
275:

Pulsa atacar varias veces para encadenar un combo de tres golpes. El tercer golpe hace más daño y empuja. Esquivar consume aguante y te hace invulnerable durante un instante. Bloquear reduce el daño; si bloqueas justo en el momento del impacto, ejecutas un paro que aturde al enemigo y rellena aguante. La barra verde se agota: sin aguante no puedes esquivar ni bloquear.

279:

Debilita a una criatura por debajo de un tercio de su vida y pulsa Capturar. La probabilidad depende de su vida restante, tu suerte y la rareza. Las criaturas capturadas luchan a tu lado: invoca una y usa su habilidad con F. La esencia de resonancia las fortalece.

283:

Sube de nivel con experiencia, reparte puntos de atributo y equipa armas, armaduras, cascos y amuletos. Cada atributo tiene un efecto medible: vitalidad, maná, aguante, daño, defensa, velocidad, poder mágico, crítico y captura. Las misiones principales avanzan la historia; las secundarias dan equipo único y lore.

## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.
